Peter,
When I was watching Bad Bunny's powerful halftime show, I was taken back to my time as a First Responder in Puerto Rico after Hurricane Maria, when our team found and rescued a puppy amid the devastation:
---
| [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001miyVIC1j0x3giyGbqBdzd4uIFgR5Z_yRWt3H4BiVOlDW4GpC10EdB7reri-UgdFPtFatWgxZmUG10EhPSa-r7qa4ykELL0FM8WpkqC18jcmR5dGL82z0rd1_Mihb3U1Fkha5MQJiS8U6l41Y1h9jKziDmUjmr8AtJdoY-_6Ce_DbehnRrcTuq6Y3wSLcIwqJgZdloOazkE1XIXqPLRTaW7HF-39CadNb_uZ3DvOi0UE=&c=9EhsmWl4CN7_4nCw5sZRHE59EHr32fzLB3dPap6-mCUCX-6ONG49EA==&ch=6PJxgaWcaCM4YVEEbr0Px_QccWTElOTI3WeCDneSN3sfa3Gx7riT9g==)
---
In moments like that, you see the very best of who we are: compassion, resilience, and a commitment to one another. At a time when Donald Trump is trying to demonize Latinos and divide our communities, that performance was a reminder that our diversity is our strength -- and that love will always be louder than fear. I couldn't help but feel emotional watching a fellow 31-year-old Latino with tan skin and curly hair command the world's biggest stage. As the son of a single mother who immigrated from Latin America, I never imagined my journey would take me to Yale, into a career as an environmental lawyer, to the state legislature, and now to a campaign for Congress. But this race isn't about me. It's about whether families in Colorado's 8th District have a representative who understands their struggles, shares their hopes, and will fight relentlessly on their behalf. This was one of the closest congressional races in the country in 2024 -- and it could decide the balance of power again. If we want to stop Trump's agenda from causing more harm in our communities, the path runs straight through this district. [That's why I'm asking for your help today. Chip in $10, $20, $30, or whatever you can to help us flip this seat blue and send a real fighter to Congress.](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001miyVIC1j0x3giyGbqBdzd4uIFgR5Z_yRWt3H4BiVOlDW4GpC10EdB7reri-UgdFPA-usi3XxMHspYQ0ulJeL5yrrugqdqykhSRAS3faz0Qi-KBSwwgOBrgvf9DRU0qk5dps1HrjywWnPykZTNxfhcbQ3L34Sg_B6U4y0145J5M8FH85-mXAZI3CyhKiMWML1FO5r867IPj1g7s9rwwxae7T3427z83k_bL-usMUhaU9RV4UW8RGTSQ==&c=9EhsmWl4CN7_4nCw5sZRHE59EHr32fzLB3dPap6-mCUCX-6ONG49EA==&ch=6PJxgaWcaCM4YVEEbr0Px_QccWTElOTI3WeCDneSN3sfa3Gx7riT9g==)

clean_body: | | | | | == Peter, When I was watching Bad Bunny's powerful halftime show, I was taken back to my time as a First Responder in Puerto Rico after Hurricane Maria, when our team found and rescued a puppy amid the devastation: | == In moments like that, you see the very best of who we are: compassion, resilience, and a commitment to one another. At a time when Donald Trump is trying to demonize Latinos and divide our communities, that performance was a reminder that our diversity is our strength -- and that love will always be louder than fear. I couldn't help but feel emotional watching a fellow 31-year-old Latino with tan skin and curly hair command the world's biggest stage. As the son of a single mother who immigrated from Latin America, I never imagined my journey would take me to Yale, into a career as an environmental lawyer, to the state legislature, and now to a campaign for Congress. But this race isn't about me. It's about whether families in Colorado's 8th District have a representative who understands their struggles, shares their hopes, and will fight relentlessly on their behalf. This was one of the closest congressional races in the country in 2024 -- and it could decide the balance of power again. In today's fast-paced world, where individualism often takes center stage, the importance of community cannot be understated. A strong and supportive community not only brings people together, but it also plays a vital role in promoting health and enabling longevity. Community involvement and connection have a positive impact on overall well-being and contribute to a longer, healthier life.
Community involvement creates social connections and provides a support system that promotes mental health. Engaging with others in a meaningful way helps combat feelings of isolation, loneliness, and depression. The recent Covid pandemic illustrated this very clearly. Sharing experiences, thoughts, and emotions with like-minded individuals can lead to a sense of belonging and purpose, ultimately enhancing mental resilience. We see this among our clients on our nutrition program, as they encourage each other on fasting days. Studies have shown that individuals with strong social support networks tend to have lower rates of anxiety and stress-related disorders, which can significantly impact long-term health.

We've learned from our Fast.Eat.Live. members that a close-knit community encourages healthier lifestyle choices. When people come together with a shared goal, it becomes easier to adopt positive habits. Communities that emphasize physical activity, healthy eating, and overall wellness, create an environment that helps one another thrive. For instance, having access to exercise facilities, recreational activities, being part of a church congregation, or being on sports teams, motivate people to maintain an active lifestyle. Likewise, community gardens or farmers' markets promote healthy eating habits and provide access to fresh, locally sourced produce.
A supportive community acts as a buffer against stress and its detrimental effects. By providing emotional support during challenging times, groups can help individuals cope with stressors more effectively. The power of family and friends is incredible. Togetherness provides a comforting presence, and reminds us that someone else cares. It can alleviate anxiety and improve resilience. In turn, reduced stress levels positively impact physical health, reducing the risk of conditions such as hypertension, heart disease, and immune system disorders.
Being part of a community provides individuals with a sense of purpose and belonging. Whether it's through volunteering, participating in community events, or engaging in shared projects, people find meaning in contributing to something larger than themselves. This sense of purpose has been linked to improved mental well-being and increased life satisfaction. Feeling valued and connected to others promotes a positive outlook on life and encourages individuals to take care of their health for the benefit of themselves and their community.
In a world where technology often distances us from real meaningful relationships, nurturing strong and supportive communities is a significant key to health. The benefits are not just limited to companionship and socializing. They extend to our overall physical and mental health, which contribute to longevity. By embracing the power of community, we can promote mental resilience, adopt healthier lifestyles, share knowledge, reduce stress, and find purpose in our lives. With Independence Day approaching, let us cherish each other and invest in building strong bonds that enrich our lives and contribute to a healthier, happier future for this country.

Peter,

It was a pleasure meeting with Equality Virginia, where we discussed building a future where we all have the safety and dignity to thrive. When equality thrives in our Commonwealth, we all thrive. I met with the Amalgamated Transit Union (ATU), the largest transit worker union in the United States. We spoke about the issues of Transit Union workers and how we can build on existing protections and advocate for better transit infrastructure and fair labor practices. Together, we’re working to support the essential workers who power our community’s daily commute. I was happy to meet with Ray Jackson, the president of the union, who works hard to advocate for workers' rights. I also met with the Local 10 Steamfitters Union. It was an honor to meet with the hardworking men and women of the Local 10 Steamfitters Union. Their union has been the backbone of Virginia’s infrastructure, ensuring our homes, hospitals, and schools are built to the highest standards of safety and excellence. I was also happy to introduce the Civic Association of Brentsville and the Surrounding Area. The work they do for members in the Greater Brentsville Area. They promote smart growth principles and advocate for the residents' best interests. They work hard to provide a unified voice for citizens on issues impacting the community. **We’re featuring excellent individuals and small businesses in the 22nd District in our newsletters! If you’d like to nominate someone or have your business be considered, please email: deleguzman@house.virginia.gov. We enjoy building relationships instead of only focusing on teeth. Our team provides exceptional, uncompromised dental care and education in a personalized, comfortable environment for you and your family. ” – Nokesville Family Dentistry Contact us and ask for Constituent Services at (804) 698-1022 , and we will make sure you are properly assisted. If you have lost power during this storm and are having trouble getting in touch with any utility company, please reach out. Do not hesitate to contact me. | | | | | | Peter,
Great news! [**Texas Values Action**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=5f69adf504&e=4d3fe76c62) has proudly endorsed my campaign for U.S. Congress in Texas’ 21st Congressional District!
Texas Values Action is a respected statewide organization dedicated to advancing pro-family, pro-life, and pro-freedom policies that protect religious liberty, defend the sanctity of life, and uphold the God-given importance of marriage and family. Their endorsement carries real weight among conservative Texans who care deeply about these foundational values.
---
[|
---](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=d92dfb424c&e=4d3fe76c62)
| | Jonathan Saenz, Executive Director of Texas Values Action, had this to say:
_“Texas Values Action proudly endorses Trey Trainor for U.S. Congress, District 21! Trey is a strong advocate for religious freedom, pro-life values, and the importance of marriage & family!”_
I am deeply honored by their trust and support. This endorsement reinforces my long-standing commitment to fighting for the issues that matter most to families in the Texas Hill Country and across TX-21:
* Protecting religious freedom from government overreach
* Defending life at every stage, from conception to natural death
* Upholding marriage as the union of one man and one woman
* Securing our borders, restoring election integrity, and advancing America First principles

With early voting starting February 17 and the March 3 Republican Primary right around the corner, momentum is building. Endorsements like this from principled organizations such as Texas Values Action show that conservative Texans know a proven fighter when they see one.
If you share these values and want strong representation in Washington, I humbly ask for your vote—and your help spreading the word. Together, we’ll keep TX-21 strong, conservative, and committed to the principles that make Texas exceptional.
For God, For Family, For Texas,
Trey TrainorHusband, Father of 6,Proven Conservative Fighter for TX-21

# **Canada 's deadliest school shooting in 37 years leaves 9 dead, 25 injured - Reports of transgender identity**
Students at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School in remote northeastern British Columbia barricaded classroom doors with tables and chairs for up to two and a half hours Tuesday as a shooter--**[described by police as a"gunperson" in a "dress"](https://substack.com/redirect/502aa3ac-dc74-4d4d-9556-9f2df41a3a8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**--carried out Canada's deadliest school shooting since 1989, killing nine people and injuring 25.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/502aa3ac-dc74-4d4d-9556-9f2df41a3a8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **What happened:** Six people, including the suspected shooter who died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound, were found dead inside the school building. Two more people were found dead at a home believed linked to the attack, and another person died while being rushed to the hospital. Students stayed locked in classrooms creating escape plans while receiving "disturbing" photos showing "blood and things like that" on their cellphones.
* **The scene:** When police arrived within two minutes of the call, they stormed classrooms yelling "Hands up, hands up" and escorted students out with their arms raised while officers swept the building for threats. Darian Quist, a 12th-grader, said the atmosphere was "very nervous" and "tense" as 14-15 students in his mechanics class shoved tables against doors. The town of Tumbler Ridge has a population of around 2,400, and Mayor Darryl Krakowka said he "broke down" after learning about the horror, adding "I probably know every one of the victims."
* **Shooter 's identity:** The identity and motive of the shooter have not been released, though an initial alert described the suspect as a "female in a dress"--fueling speculation the shooter may have been transgender after police later used the term "gunperson." Royal Canadian Mounted Police Superintendent Ken Floyd said authorities are "following all leads" but acknowledged "we will struggle to determine the 'why.'" The school, which enrolls around 160 students ages 12-18, has been closed for the rest of the week.

#
I’m sorry to reach out to ask for your financial support again, Peter, but I hope you take it as a sign of how important tonight’s FEC deadline is.
The reality is I hate asking for money. If I could run this campaign without sending a single fundraising email or text or without making a single fundraising call, I would.
But politicians in Washington and the Supreme Court have made it so that billionaires and corporations can funnel unlimited sums of money into these Senate campaigns. The whole thing is broken and corrupt.
If we unilaterally disarm against it, we might as well be bringing a knife to a gun fight. I refuse to do that. I got into this race because I believe people like you deserve a real fighter in Washington.
So we’ll raise the resources. But we’ll do it the right way — without compromising our values or selling out to the corrupt special interests that profit off the broken status quo. That means raising money one small donation at a time from people like you — not a dime from corporate PACs. And I won’t waste my time begging billionaires who want tax cuts and special favors.
My vote and my values will never be for sale. What’s best for working people in Texas will always come first.
I hate to ask, but I hope you understand why I have to.

Karoline Leavitt and I go _way_ back.

Granite Staters saw right through the spin and knew she’d put Donald Trump before the issues that matter most to our communities.
Unfortunately Trump saw that too — and now we all have to see her in the White House briefing room.
Those MAGA values don’t hold up, no matter if they’re coming from Karoline Leavitt or any other opponent. **That’s why the MAGA machine is working overtime to buy this Senate seat.**

name: David Hogg
subject: Eleanor Holmes Norton
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Thank you, Congresswoman Norton.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260211-1&t=1&akid=3141%2E587540%2EiE-JkU)
Peter, some moments deserve more than a headline. This is one of them:
Pioneering civil rights lawyer, DC statehood advocate, and longtime delegate for Washington in the US House, Congresswoman Eleanor Holmes Norton, is retiring.
First and foremost, I want to say one thing:
**Thank you, Congresswoman Norton.**
Thank you for being a relentless champion, fighting year after year for DC statehood when powerful people told you it was inconvenient or impossible.
Thank you for that unforgettable moment on the House floor — when you refused to yield, when you demanded to be heard, when you made it clear that democracy doesn’t stop at the city limits of the capital. That moment mattered. It still does.
I am thankful for the fighting spirit that Eleanor Holmes Norton always brought to Congress. And I’m grateful she’s letting a new generation rise to carry it forward.
This retirement isn’t happening in a vacuum, either.
* Nancy Pelosi said she’s retiring after more than 40 years in Congress.
* Steny Hoyer, the longest-serving House Democrat in history, did the same.
* Dick Durbin, one of the most senior Dems in the Senate, is also retiring.

These major pillars of Democratic leadership are stepping back for new leaders to step up and take the reins — and that’s incredibly important for our nation’s future.
**[Will you help us grow the momentum for electing young progressive leaders? Make a $5 contribution right now to power our game-changing work.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260211_1_norton.yqFv5a&refcode=em20260211-3141&amount=5&t=2&akid=3141%2E587540%2EiE-JkU)**
Older Democrats are sending an important signal to a new generation of leaders. But young people don't automatically get to lead just because the door opens.
Young candidates need a real foundation of support so they can walk through those doors and become the leaders we need fighting back in the halls of power.
**That’s why we built Leaders We Deserve.**
We exist to recruit, train, and elect young, bold, progressive leaders who are ready to fight for their communities with the same moral clarity Eleanor Holmes Norton brought to the House floor — and with the real urgency this moment demands.
The Democratic Party can renew itself. But only if we choose to invest in its future.
**[If you want to help us elect a new generation of bold progressives who will continue and expand the fights our older leaders started, pitch in $5 now.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260211_1_norton.yqFv5a&refcode=em20260211-3141&amount=5&t=3&akid=3141%2E587540%2EiE-JkU)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260211_1_norton.yqFv5a&amount=5&refcode=em20260211-3141&t=22&akid=3141%2E587540%2EiE-JkU)**
Thank you for your support, Peter.
— David Hogg

Hi Peter, it’s Andy Levin, former Congressman for Michigan’s 9th
district.

I read this recently, and it stopped me in my tracks:

[ A ]A post from @MorePerfectUS: 'U.S workers are taking home the smallest
share of the economic pie since the feds started collecting the data in
1947.'

In the richest country in the world, in a time when we’re more productive
than ever, working people are bringing home less of what they create —
while CEOs rake in record-breaking profits.

That didn’t happen by accident.

It happened because corporations learned how to rig the rules, and too
many politicians learned how to look the other way in exchange for a
campaign check.

This midterm election is about whether we keep accepting that bargain . .
. or finally break free.

That’s why I’m proud to support Abdul El-Sayed for U.S. Senate.

Abdul is running a campaign powered by working people, for working people.
He’s the only candidate in this race who has never taken money from a
corporate PAC and never will, meaning you know he’s fighting for our best
interests, not for billionaires.

Abdul believes that every worker deserves the right to join a union, and
he’s not afraid to stand up to corporations that have warped our economy
and our politics.

But standing with workers makes you a target.

Corporations that profit from low wages, weak labor laws, and rigged rules
don’t tolerate leaders like Abdul — they attack. And because he won’t take
their money, they’re preparing to spend whatever it takes to try to defeat
him.

campaign isn’t easy, but with your support, I know Abdul can win this race
and champion workers’ rights in the U.S. Senate.

name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: The book Charlie left behind
body:
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taaxn6&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taaxn6&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taaxn6&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taaxn6&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taaxn6&__onlt=h)**

---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children. By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: “God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.” His book, Stop, in the Name of God is the fruit of that conviction. When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family. Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive... A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us. I believe you will find this book inspiring. Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life. In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans... ...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — it’s the message of FAITH! In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God. Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. And it’s happening. After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country. What we’re witnessing is not just growth —it’s revival. At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old. We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families. We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message. You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie. But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up. All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, “We’re not backing down.” This is what Charlie prayed for. I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too. None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith. Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God. I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible. Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S. When you read Stop, in the Name of God, you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead. ** 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 / / DISCLOSURE OF BUSINESS TIES: The sender of this email likely has an affiliate or material connection with the entities mentioned and may earn commissions from purchases made through associated websites. body:
It was the hardest decision I've ever made.

[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckT2PnDAQhn-N6UD2AAYKF5FOJM2lSBOlsmbtMWsFjOOPvdt_H5EofXT988zH-35_1a_odx-2r3iQSsXplLW_17DVeDxjopxvaDfCYH9Vr4GDbDm0QuiYzhzJFC0aq6yxKExDSkwTn2GUMDd3NfYLgsBldDe3WMdnAYSj4xMZe4PRNl5dAzkIISTnMHSzGOal5zjKkcCahQ0cd0qlSxTrbfcGQ8H8053JUGfOo9nVvZSYWf-JwcpgzWRqou7Nh0T2IhisBd35xNadqc0UsBCDFUM4azB0UCiX2a_pMpMPG-tfSqrEQNZyaINHRL8F1r_8vZWD_vyl_fGtE2KGadRFzHyRMLSD4D0DSe-6ePvf-HsNj2vjo03Ftf_iaJKy8c3vu89yYgPfDvT7n4fLR0t6KPgdAAD__8WnnJE) Hi there, I hope you are well!
[This is Michele Tafoya - I've got a quick story to share if you'll indulge me for a few moments.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckT2PnDAQhn-N6UD2AAYKF5FOJM2lSBOlsmbtMWsFjOOPvdt_H5EofXT988zH-35_1a_odx-2r3iQSsXplLW_17DVeDxjopxvaDfCYH9Vr4GDbDm0QuiYzhzJFC0aq6yxKExDSkwTn2GUMDd3NfYLgsBldDe3WMdnAYSj4xMZe4PRNl5dAzkIISTnMHSzGOal5zjKkcCahQ0cd0qlSxTrbfcGQ8H8053JUGfOo9nVvZSYWf-JwcpgzWRqou7Nh0T2IhisBd35xNadqc0UsBCDFUM4azB0UCiX2a_pMpMPG-tfSqrEQNZyaINHRL8F1r_8vZWD_vyl_fGtE2KGadRFzHyRMLSD4D0DSe-6ePvf-HsNj2vjo03Ftf_iaJKy8c3vu89yYgPfDvT7n4fLR0t6KPgdAAD__8WnnJE)
Folks might've killed to have my job.
I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. I covered some of the most exciting games in history. I watched sports for a living. And I loved every minute, every touchdown, and every Hail Mary.
I reached the pinnacle of my career... but there was one problem:
I had to watch what I said. I was a public-facing representative for a world-class sports network. I couldn't share everything I believed, and no one really knew I was a Conservative.
So I hung up my press badge and quit my dream job so I could speak my mind. [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckT2PnDAQhn-N6UD2AAYKF5FOJM2lSBOlsmbtMWsFjOOPvdt_H5EofXT988zH-35_1a_odx-2r3iQSsXplLW_17DVeDxjopxvaDfCYH9Vr4GDbDm0QuiYzhzJFC0aq6yxKExDSkwTn2GUMDd3NfYLgsBldDe3WMdnAYSj4xMZe4PRNl5dAzkIISTnMHSzGOal5zjKkcCahQ0cd0qlSxTrbfcGQ8H8053JUGfOo9nVvZSYWf-JwcpgzWRqou7Nh0T2IhisBd35xNadqc0UsBCDFUM4azB0UCiX2a_pMpMPG-tfSqrEQNZyaINHRL8F1r_8vZWD_vyl_fGtE2KGadRFzHyRMLSD4D0DSe-6ePvf-HsNj2vjo03Ftf_iaJKy8c3vu89yYgPfDvT7n4fLR0t6KPgdAAD__8WnnJE) It was the hardest decision I've ever made. I was scared, excited, and liberated - all at the same time. ** ** People said I was OUT OF MY MIND. ** ** But I knew God was leading me in a certain direction, and that's no time for half-measures. I knew he had a plan for my life. So I took a leap of faith and never looked back. ** ** [Now, a few years later, I've started a growing podcast, campaigned for commonsense in Minnesota, and now launched a campaign for U.S. Senate!](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckT2PnDAQhn-N6UD2AAYKF5FOJM2lSBOlsmbtMWsFjOOPvdt_H5EofXT988zH-35_1a_odx-2r3iQSsXplLW_17DVeDxjopxvaDfCYH9Vr4GDbDm0QuiYzhzJFC0aq6yxKExDSkwTn2GUMDd3NfYLgsBldDe3WMdnAYSj4xMZe4PRNl5dAzkIISTnMHSzGOal5zjKkcCahQ0cd0qlSxTrbfcGQ8H8053JUGfOo9nVvZSYWf-JwcpgzWRqou7Nh0T2IhisBd35xNadqc0UsBCDFUM4azB0UCiX2a_pMpMPG-tfSqrEQNZyaINHRL8F1r_8vZWD_vyl_fGtE2KGadRFzHyRMLSD4D0DSe-6ePvf-HsNj2vjo03Ftf_iaJKy8c3vu89yYgPfDvT7n4fLR0t6KPgdAAD__8WnnJE) ** ** I believe God put me here for a reason. ** ** I believe Minnesota is the land of 10,000 problems right now. ** ** And I believe a no-BS, sane person who's ALL-IN can win this seat. ** ** But I'd be lying if I said fundraising doesn't make a difference in a race like this. The far-Left is readying a FORTUNE to drown out our message and take this seat out of play. ** ** Our path to victory solely depends on raising enough to keep up. ** ** My finance team tells me we'll need to bring in 10,000 founding donors ASAP so we can: 1) Hire staff, 2) Recruit volunteers in every corner of the state, 3) Print yard signs, 4) Launch our first advertising blitz, and 5) Start contacting on-the-fence voters. ** ** I'm afraid that'll make the difference between a winning campaign and a losing one. Donations in these early days make the biggest impact on our path to victory. ** ** I hope you'll join us, but either way, God bless you! ** ** Be brave. clean_body: It was the hardest decision I've ever made. Hi there, I hope you are well! Folks might've killed to have my job. I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. I covered some of the most exciting games in history. I watched sports for a living. And I loved every minute, every touchdown, and every Hail Mary. I reached the pinnacle of my career... but there was one problem: I had to watch what I said. I was a public-facing representative for a world-class sports network. I couldn't share everything I believed, and no one really knew I was a Conservative. So I hung up my press badge and quit my dream job so I could speak my mind. It was the hardest decision I've ever made. I was scared, excited, and liberated - all at the same time. People said I was OUT OF MY MIND. But I knew God was leading me in a certain direction, and that's no time for half-measures. I knew he had a plan for my life. So I took a leap of faith and never looked back. I believe God put me here for a reason. I believe Minnesota is the land of 10,000 problems right now. And I believe a no-BS, sane person who's ALL-IN can win this seat. But I'd be lying if I said fundraising doesn't make a difference in a race like this. The far-Left is readying a FORTUNE to drown out our message and take this seat out of play. Our path to victory solely depends on raising enough to keep up. My finance team tells me we'll need to bring in 10,000 founding donors ASAP so we can: 1) Hire staff, 2) Recruit volunteers in every corner of the state, 3) Print yard signs, 4) Launch our first advertising blitz, and 5) Start contacting on-the-fence voters. I'm afraid that'll make the difference between a winning campaign and a losing one. I put my career on hold to speak out for what I know to be true. I'm committing my blood, sweat, and tears to take this seat back from the political class. I'd be honored if you'd be willing to stand alongside me. Donations in these early days make the biggest impact on our path to victory. I hope you'll join us, but either way, God bless you! Be brave. Do good. - Michele Michele Tafoya Republican for Senate, Minnesota It's official - Michele Tafoya is running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota! Powered by People was built on a simple belief: the best way to strengthen our democracy is by meeting voters where they are and staying with them until they’ve cast their votes.
Across Texas and in communities like yours, volunteers with Powered by People are registering voters, helping neighbors make a plan to vote, and showing up in places that have been ignored for far too long.
_We don’t just organize where it’s easy—we organize everywhere it’s needed._
When we register people and personally give them help to vote, we win elections. And winning elections is the only thing that’s going to save our country right now.
The stakes couldn’t be higher. Trump has openly admitted that he’s trying to rig the contest. His administration continues to send tens of thousands of federal shock troops into Democratic cities. They’re killing U.S. citizens in the streets. We either win these upcoming elections or we lose this country forever.
Powered by People volunteers are on the front lines, meeting the margin of victory across the state of Texas. Registering, organizing, and personally pushing people to vote in the most important elections of our lives.

| | Friend,
I woke up this morning to an unhinged, diatribe in a left-wing newspaper by a left-wing professor so disgusting and dripping with hate that honestly, you need to read it to believe it.
He starts by calling me a "race traitor" and then unloads with this:
---
|
---
_"Cameron is the type of**loyal Black servant** who betrayed his brothers to White people and got Gabriel Prosser and Denmark Vesey killed in 1800 and 1822. He’s the **sycophantic big house protector** that Nat Turner told his people not to trust in 1831, and Malcolm warned us about over 130 years later. He’s the type of **lost whitewashed soul** that Harriet Tubman left behind because he has no desire to be free. **He is a Black man who hates Black people and takes every opportunity to prove it to his masters.** He should be ashamed, but doesn’t have sufficient conscience, self-awareness or self-love to feel so."_
---
|
---
There is a special type of hatred that left-wingers have for black conservatives like me, and here you have it on full-display.
__**I share this with you not because I'm looking for sympathy, but because I want you to be energized by it.**__
**What you just read is proof that conservatives are finally fighting back and crushing the far Left's Marxist and almost- demonic crusade that has been poisoning our kids, our classrooms, our corporations and our entire culture for far too long.**
This lunacy – _from an actual professor who teaches our young people_ – is what DEI and CRT really looks like.
It is foaming-at-the-mouth hatred for not only for their fellow Americans, but for the very heart of the American creed of color-blindness before the law and meritocracy.
_**So here's what I'm asking you right now...**_
**Double down on our righteous campaign to eliminate this toxic poison from every nook and cranny of this great country.**
As Kentucky's Attorney General and for my entire career, I've been fighting this garbage on behalf of Americans of every color and background – and I'm ready to lead this fight in the U.S. Senate.
**This ideology destroys everything it touches, and we must ruthlessly uproot it without apology or delay.**
[**I will be a fearless warrior for this cause in the U.S. Senate, and today of all days, I am asking for your ongoing and generous support.**](https://eot.cameronforkentucky.com/f/a/5is_XFDeYC9SzzMFo3rVeA~~/AAAHURA~/DCLYNF2MUuM_kM3lUFmuuMXX-AKTKgkYQLbspnHg0OMB0lz5mkClKGShHtPj66Y5ddU2PxXyEYSG7Z_zoIj3MfsjpDMDw_6P_91WEjSMN4BF4ANgjY9tgLXCB8akYcCJti4yY9toGEpNonCgOwBljRkE0RIYDC0pGGP9zbrvfl_osS7N-yfqyNlnzuG_KLFKmcFIMkFv9oQOwS1ShOH_cIZxnq6xW-mYiFYnP-6yqNgQIqosIySLEC-ojZGQANx4aGU7DmTHuBbFEKPRb-m4Hg~~)
Thank you for your support, it means the world to my family and me.
Sincerely,Daniel Cameron

| | Friends,
Real experience and leadership are not learned from a textbook or proven through political rhetoric. They are proven in real moments. They are tested when it is inconvenient. And they are revealed when the phone rings.
This past Super Bowl Sunday is a real example of what that responsibility looks like.
Under the Michigan Constitution and state law, the Attorney General is the chief law enforcement officer for the State of Michigan. At the county level, that responsibility falls to the elected Prosecuting Attorney. As Eaton County Prosecutor, there is no 9-5\. I am on call 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
So when the phone rings, I answer. High-stakes situations demand experience, judgment, and leadership.
My Super Bowl Sunday began with calls from law enforcement partners regarding a deceased individual discovered at a residence in the City of Lansing. Because a portion of Lansing falls within Eaton County, the matter required my direct involvement as prosecuting attorney.
In an active homicide investigation, the prosecutor does not conduct the investigation. The prosecutor ensures it is done lawfully and correctly. That means providing real-time legal guidance on crime scene protocols, constitutional limits, and evidentiary standards for search warrants. Throughout the day and into the evening, I remained in constant communication with investigators and responded to the scene to assist with reviewing and authorizing search warrants. There is no room for error.
What happens in the first hours, and sometimes days, can determine whether justice is ultimately served if a death is later ruled criminal by the medical examiner. Those decisions also affect victims and their families, public safety, and the integrity of our justice system.
I have been honored to receive endorsements from law enforcement across Michigan, and especially humbled by the support of retired Chief of Police and former [Eaton Rapids Mayor Paul Malewski, who recently wrote in support of my candidacy.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O80EUBLmSLFd4CAyCQ--1k1Z1auiClVgvoIocCzjVHz51GJ3cFKJ4EqETK7QiN5giZmo1GJxkEer23CPEVvtOAlkHW01C1UxacPjFkzFlKfZejc4lNYdrc9_yEM3fhpPNMLNXj_Pr10efj7l8X1p5AoU80wWl7ZUdukEsv_ISKlPPcujAMQezj8ZlLcynMxwsjuzRmSMNk-WZYaeIJ6NMTlJb3ktq6lV7WS34ww7sf-uXpfE8FLydI2ApkqnZ7inFhNOm_QZ0J8=&c=eJBA4tlHEgRPJvONXpkTlRlmWd9gMNQWl0KoqZY9qug5ZhJfSYe5rg==&ch=LVkuf6aXYrIdLxXvWDs58Vv8ausB9G9D7hk_83RrKmnfUlcm6aA7GQ==)
In moments like that Sunday, there is no politics. There is only responsibility. I will bring that same experience, judgment, and commitment to restoring priorities and integrity to the Michigan Attorney General's Office.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

At the county level, that responsibility falls to the elected Prosecuting Attorney. As Eaton County Prosecutor, there is no 9-5\. I am on call 24 hours a day, seven days a week. So when the phone rings, I answer. High-stakes situations demand experience, judgment, and leadership. My Super Bowl Sunday began with calls from law enforcement partners regarding a deceased individual discovered at a residence in the City of Lansing. Because a portion of Lansing falls within Eaton County, the matter required my direct involvement as prosecuting attorney. In an active homicide investigation, the prosecutor does not conduct the investigation. The prosecutor ensures it is done lawfully and correctly. That means providing real-time legal guidance on crime scene protocols, constitutional limits, and evidentiary standards for search warrants. Throughout the day and into the evening, I remained in constant communication with investigators and responded to the scene to assist with reviewing and authorizing search warrants. There is no room for error. What happens in the first hours, and sometimes days, can determine whether justice is ultimately served if a death is later ruled criminal by the medical examiner. Those decisions also affect victims and their families, public safety, and the integrity of our justice system. I have been honored to receive endorsements from law enforcement across Michigan, and especially humbled by the support of retired Chief of Police and former == In moments like that Sunday, there is no politics. There is only responsibility. I will bring that same experience, judgment, and commitment to restoring priorities and integrity to the Michigan Attorney General's Office. ---
| Peter,
If you've been with us at Defend Our Courts this past year, you remember the name Scott Pressler. We exposed how the MAGA operative and his group, Early Vote Action, were leading the charge to capture Pennsylvania's Supreme Court.
Pressler is a darling of right-wing organizers, widely considered one of their most effective operatives. Elon Musk has bankrolled his rise, hiring him to lead last year's failed bid to flip the Wisconsin Supreme Court. After that loss, Pressler turned his operation toward Pennsylvania, attempting to topple the PA Supreme Court next.
Because of you, Peter, we didn't just defeat Pressler. We buried him by 30+ points across Pennsylvania in November. A landslide loss and a brutal blow to his oversized ego.
Now Pressler is back. Rather than rethink the toxic politics voters just rejected, he marched to Capitol Hill to beg Congress to rig elections for MAGA:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zTf6A6WBY8wt1mS6jCqahEezczvtnvWgMgy9ydeRlT90X7BfLkROjf3iirQgIEgD3t0VINa9K9Z_6RtM0DhYN0VSoVoReN-sECO-Mg2d51EDu99KgPgPo-ilN8xzBpD0b77zgHc9qEElkc0i5ykKUFX3d4Za77o0YfowF_egLkxQDjt08PG-XNuLewUso-n-uXnLe6ZP2QAAHzFf4Nm7iDBUxqv2Xvz7KN7EqX9A-Jw=&c=an1vtT01snUA_sMaj2kM1tqZ4TPaQ2kCRuCGbqlKLhKVNTYwIMKXZQ==&ch=Fy4kf2zBt3KiOT9DAW8GG558keUwQPgp0KGgM79QOCpssBUWas6lqg==)
---
As they famously say: "If you can't beat 'em, rig it."
---
This is so pathetic.
After getting blown out repeatedly, Pressler marched into Congress and said the quiet part out loud: MAGA has to rig elections to stop another 2018-style midterm wipeout.
By Pressler's own admission, the SAVE Act has nothing to do with election integrity. It's about voter disenfranchisement. The bill MAGA is trying to ram through Congress would strip millions of Americans of their right to vote. In some states, it could effectively ban mail-in voting and open the door to prosecuting election workers.
But thankfully, we have a chance to outmaneuver Pressler again. MAGA has one major flaw in the SAVE Act: elections are controlled by states, not the federal government.
That means state Supreme Courts will play a decisive role in how any federal voting law is interpreted and enforced.
And it means Defend Our Courts' mission is more important than ever. We're taking the model that embarrassed Pressler in PA nationwide, scaling up to battle MAGA in key states like Georgia, Michigan, and Wisconsin this year.
Our win in PA wasn't just built by our team here at DoC HQ. It was powered by more than 100,000 Democrats across the country who chipped in their hard-earned dollars to fuel a winning program.
We would love to have you on this team in 2026, Peter.

clean_body: Rather than rethink the toxic politics voters just rejected, he marched to Capitol Hill to beg Congress to rig elections for MAGA. | | | | | == | Peter, If you've been with us at Defend Our Courts this past year, you remember the name Scott Pressler. We exposed how the MAGA operative and his group, Early Vote Action, were leading the charge to capture Pennsylvania's Supreme Court. Pressler is a darling of right-wing organizers, widely considered one of their most effective operatives. Elon Musk has bankrolled his rise, hiring him to lead last year's failed bid to flip the Wisconsin Supreme Court. After that loss, Pressler turned his operation toward Pennsylvania, attempting to topple the PA Supreme Court next. Because of you, Peter, we didn't just defeat Pressler. We buried him by 30+ points across Pennsylvania in November. A landslide loss and a brutal blow to his oversized ego. Now Pressler is back. Rather than rethink the toxic politics voters just rejected, he marched to Capitol Hill to beg Congress to rig elections for MAGA: | == As they famously say: "If you can't beat 'em, rig it." This is so pathetic. After getting blown out repeatedly, Pressler marched into Congress and said the quiet part out loud: MAGA has to rig elections to stop another 2018-style midterm wipeout. By Pressler's own admission, the SAVE Act has nothing to do with election integrity. It's about voter disenfranchisement. The bill MAGA is trying to ram through Congress would strip millions of Americans of their right to vote. In some states, it could effectively ban mail-in voting and open the door to prosecuting election workers. But thankfully, we have a chance to outmaneuver Pressler again. MAGA has one major flaw in the SAVE Act: elections are controlled by states, not the federal government. That means state Supreme Courts will play a decisive role in how any federal voting law is interpreted and enforced. And it means Defend Our Courts' mission is more important than ever. We're taking the model that embarrassed Pressler in PA nationwide, scaling up to battle MAGA in key states like Georgia, Michigan, and Wisconsin this year. Our win in PA wasn't just built by our team here at DoC HQ. It was powered by more than 100,000 Democrats across the country who chipped in their hard-earned dollars to fuel a winning program. body:
#

We’re just nine months out from the 2026 midterms, and the President has openly called on Republicans to “TAKE OVER” our elections.
He sent Tulsi Gabbard, the nation’s spy chief, and the FBI to raid a Georgia election office and seize truckloads of ballots.
I won’t waste time pontificating about how serious this is. So here’s the bottom line: I need your help to ensure we have a secure midterm election in Georgia in 2026.
**Please, rush $15 right now to support my campaign here in Georgia, help expand our voter turnout operations, strengthen our defense of Georgians’ voting rights, and make sure every eligible voter can cast a ballot and have it counted.**
**Here's the link to donate:[https://act.electjon.com/go/Donate](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260211-1-subs-a&t=1&akid=1617%2E5691347%2EsfW-Sj)**
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
I ran for Senate in 2020 because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible.
But the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. They said Trump couldn’t be beat here. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history — and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.
Fast-forward six years, I am the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024. This is the most critical and competitive race in the midterms.
Today, from Minnesota to Georgia, we are watching the President unravel as he abuses federal power to pursue vendettas and consolidate power.
He is signaling his intent to attack our elections.
That’s why we have to triple down on voter mobilization and voter protection.
We have to win by decisive margins and we have to protect voting rights.
It takes resources. We have to turn out every Democrat and make sure every eligible vote is properly cast, protected, and counted.
[**So if you’re worried — and you’re ready to help us win one of the most important races of 2026 –– rush $15 to my reelection campaign in Georgia right now.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260211-1-subs-a&t=2&akid=1617%2E5691347%2EsfW-Sj)
We need all the help we can get to turn out voters and protect voting rights this year.
Every dollar you give supports our work in Georgia.
Thank you.
Jon Ossoff
**[DONATE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260211-1-subs-a&t=3&akid=1617%2E5691347%2EsfW-Sj)**

Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate

Email is a critical way to keep up with Jon and his work in the US Senate, but you can click [here](https://act.electjon.com/signup/fewer-emails-signup/?t=4&akid=1617%2E5691347%2EsfW-Sj) to sign up to receive fewer emails, or click [here](https://act.electjon.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=5&akid=1617%2E5691347%2EsfW-Sj) if you'd like to unsubscribe.

subject: AIPAC’s grip is slipping. Here’s why.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Cori Bush here. As many of you know, I’m running for Missouri’s 1st
congressional district again—because our movement is not done, not beaten,
and absolutely not backing down.

I know because AIPAC’s grip on Washington is starting to slip, and our
movement is right at the center of it.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260211-cb.fBx-Eg&refcode=em20260211-37456&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37456%2E1203867%2EJP42Ce ]The New York Times: Democrats Pull Away From AIPAC, Reflecting a
Broader Shift. A quiet retreat by Democrats from the preeminent pro-Israel
lobbying group is the latest evidence of a realignment underway in
Congress on Israel.

They spent more than $23 million to defeat Jamaal Bowman and me, two of
the loudest progressive voices standing up for peace. They didn’t just
come for my seat. They came for our movement.

But something has changed.

The public is waking up, opinion is shifting. Democratic voters no longer
give unconditional support to Netanyahu’s far-right government. Members of
Congress, even establishment Democrats who once relied on AIPAC’s money
are walking away and rethinking their ties.

And why? Because of voices like mine and Justice Democrats, voices that
refuse to back down, even when the cost is enormous.

It’s only the beginning. There’s a crack in the glass that’s shattering
AIPAC’s grip on our democracy and the Democratic Party.

Now it’s time to finish the work we started, to take that crack and turn
it into a chasm wide enough to let our democracy breathe. The movement
we’ve built, the one you are part of, is alive. It’s growing. And it’s
needed now more than ever.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260211-cb.fBx-Eg&refcode=em20260211-37456&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=37456%2E1203867%2EJP42Ce ]That’s why I’m asking you, right now: will you consider splitting a
donation between my campaign and Justice Democrats to keep building the
kind of movement money can’t buy?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260211-cb.fBx-Eg&refcode=em20260211-37456&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=37456%2E1203867%2EJP42Ce ]Contribute $5

Because if AIPAC can spend millions to take down some of the most
principled voices in Congress, they’ll do it again, going after anyone who
dares challenge their power.

The only way we fight back is with people power, one donation, one
volunteer, one act of courage at a time. So let’s do it.

In solidarity,

Cori Bush

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20260211-37456-footer&t=1023&refcode2=37456_1203867_JP42Ce&akid=37456%2E1203867%2EJP42Ce

**_Citizens United_ is one of the most damaging Supreme Court decisions in modern history.**
For 16 years, _Citizens United_ has allowed unfettered and unregulated amounts of money to flood our elections, putting our democracy at the mercy of whoever writes the biggest check.
In the 2024 election alone, Elon Musk funneled over $290 million through his super PAC in support of Trump. An unfathomable amount of money for a single individual to wield in our democracy. That’s how _Citizens United_ lets the ultra-wealthy overshadow the voices of millions of working people.
Now the same dark money that helped pave the way for Trump’s authoritarian takeover is already working overtime on polluting our elections this year.

name: Jacky Rosen
subject: As a Jewish lawmaker, the threat and impact of antisemitism is part of my story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
My faith is deeply tied to who I am, what I fight for, and my role as a lawmaker.
| | |
---
Friend,
I am the third Jewish woman and the first former synagogue president ever elected to the U.S. Senate. My faith is deeply tied to who I am, what I fight for, and my role as a lawmaker.
It’s part of why I care about the issues that I do, and it means that I bring with me the same struggles that all Jews face. They’re deploying masked and unidentified agents to carry out immigration enforcement — despite the clear risks to public safety and our basic civil liberties.
That’s why California passed a law last fall called the No Vigilantes Act that requires both state and federal law enforcement officers to clearly display their identification.
Trump sued to block that law from going into effect — and yesterday, a federal court ruled against him, upholding the identification requirement.
This is a clear win for the transparency and accountability that effective law enforcement requires.
But we have more work to do:
In the same breath, the court also ruled against another law, the No Secret Police Act , that would ban federal immigration agents from covering their faces.

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. body:

| | | [](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tab2jy&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tab2jy&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tab2jy&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tab2jy&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tab2jy&__onlt=h)**
---

---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

HB 5044, embedded in Connecticut's state budget, proposes a major structural change: transferring authority over the state's immunization program schedule from the legislature to the Commissioner of the Connecticut Department of Public Health.
_This is not a standalone bill receiving extended public scrutiny. It is folded into must-pass legislation which is problematic._
# What is the issue of HB 5044? - There are many but:
The bill would allow Manisha Juthani -- appointed by Governor Ned Lamont -- to modify Connecticut's vaccine requirements without returning to the General Assembly for approval of specific additions.
HB5044 also extends immunization standards beyond childhood and into the general adult population.
This is not simply about vaccines.
It is about who decides and a growing trend of states (especially blue ones) for regionalizing the impact of the CDC with a state override on federal vaccine schedules with no accountability.
## Delegation Today, Insulation Tomorrow
When legislatures delegate substantive policymaking authority to executive agencies, that power rarely returns.
If immunization requirements remain legislative:
* Lawmakers must debate expansions.
* Voters can influence policy through elections.
* Changes require public votes.

If authority is delegated:
* Decisions move to administrative rulemaking.
* Reversal becomes bureaucratically difficult.
* Courts replace legislatures as the battleground.

Delegation can function as insulation -- protecting policy from future political change.
In a state where one party controls nearly every branch of government, structural transfers of authority deserve heightened scrutiny.
## The Yale Ecosystem Question and Who is Manisha Juthani?
This debate cannot ignore Connecticut's institutional landscape.
**Yale University is one of the largest employers in the state and a dominant economic force in New Haven. Through Yale New Haven Health, its influence extends statewide.**
In 2025, New Haven mayoral candidate Steve Orosco raised concerns about Yale's tax-exempt status and its outsized influence over municipal policy while the tax-exempt status threatened public safety and operation of New Haven.
**That discussion is no longer purely regional when** :
* Major healthcare systems operate statewide,
* Academic institutions shape public health discourse,
* Executive leadership and regulatory agencies exist within the same institutional ecosystem,

Legislative oversight becomes more important -- not less.
**This is not about accusations of wrongdoing - It is about structural balance and Connecticut has no Balance of Power in a one party rule.**
It should be noted that the existing law as amended requires Connecticut through the Commissioner "to provide at no cost to health care providers in Connecticut to administer to children so that cost of vaccines will not be a barrier to age appropriate vaccination in this state" so it is in the interest of hospital networks to expand the required vaccines for additional revenue.
_**Manisha Juthani served as a professor of medicine at Yale School of Medicine through September 2024 and currently serves as an adjunct professor of medicine so Yale still influences her directly through this adjunct role.**_
## What Happens If There Are Problems to this Delegation?
When authority is centralized and concerns later arise -- such as policy errors, conflicts of interest, unintended consequences -- there is usually no automatic legislative trigger for correction.
The legislature will have already stepped back once HB 5044 is passed and the baton has passed.
**Reclaiming delegated authority is historically rare and politically difficult.**
_**That is why guardrails matter before power is transferred. Unfortunately other guardrails have been eroded or removed such as the fiscal guardrails in this state.**_
## HB 5044 is Bigger Than One Bill
HB 5044 affects **the structure of governance in Connecticut.**
Efficiency cannot replace accountability and with an ever expanding budget, there is certainly no efficiency and clearly no accountability.
## Take Action - What Can You Do?
The Goldstein Team has supported grassroots advocacy alongside
Connecticut Residents Against Medical Mandates (CTRAMM) because organized citizens are the only counterbalance when authority consolidates quietly.

If authority is delegated: Decisions move to administrative rulemaking. Reversal becomes bureaucratically difficult. Courts replace legislatures as the battleground. Delegation can function as insulation -- protecting policy from future political change. In a state where one party controls nearly every branch of government, structural transfers of authority deserve heightened scrutiny. The Yale Ecosystem Question and Who is Manisha Juthani? This debate cannot ignore Connecticut's institutional landscape. Yale University is one of the largest employers in the state and a dominant economic force in New Haven. Through Yale New Haven Health, its influence extends statewide. In 2025, New Haven mayoral candidate Steve Orosco raised concerns about Yale's tax-exempt status and its outsized influence over municipal policy while the tax-exempt status threatened public safety and operation of New Haven. That discussion is no longer purely regional when : Major healthcare systems operate statewide, Academic institutions shape public health discourse, Executive leadership and regulatory agencies exist within the same institutional ecosystem, Legislative oversight becomes more important -- not less. This is not about accusations of wrongdoing - It is about structural balance and Connecticut has no Balance of Power in a one party rule. It should be noted that the existing law as amended requires Connecticut through the Commissioner "to provide at no cost to health care providers in Connecticut to administer to children so that cost of vaccines will not be a barrier to age appropriate vaccination in this state" so it is in the interest of hospital networks to expand the required vaccines for additional revenue. Manisha Juthani served as a professor of medicine at Yale School of Medicine through September 2024 and currently serves as an adjunct professor of medicine so Yale still influences her directly through this adjunct role. What Happens If There Are Problems to this Delegation? When authority is centralized and concerns later arise -- such as policy errors, conflicts of interest, unintended consequences -- there is usually no automatic legislative trigger for correction. The legislature will have already stepped back once HB 5044 is passed and the baton has passed. Reclaiming delegated authority is historically rare and politically difficult. That is why guardrails matter before power is transferred. Unfortunately other guardrails have been eroded or removed such as the fiscal guardrails in this state. HB 5044 is Bigger Than One Bill HB 5044 affects the structure of governance in Connecticut. Efficiency cannot replace accountability and with an ever expanding budget, there is certainly no efficiency and clearly no accountability. Take Action - What Can You Do? The Goldstein Team has supported grassroots advocacy alongside Connecticut Residents Against Medical Mandates (CTRAMM) because organized citizens are the only counterbalance when authority consolidates quietly. If you believe major public health decisions should involve elected representatives: 1 ️⃣ Sign the petition: 2 ️⃣ Share this publication. 3 ️⃣ Subscribe for updates and stay engaged. Connecticut's future should be shaped through open legislative debate by the citizens of this Constitution State -- not quiet delegation embedded in a budget bill. Democracy requires participation -- especially when power shifts quietly (especially with minimal media coverage). | | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...
