It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. Peter, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. That's the heartbeat of his final message. Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth. He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth... For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal. Peter, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage. These are the very things Charlie gave his life for. May the message he left behind lead you -- just as it led him -- to a deeper trust in God... A stronger love for your family... And a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S.Stop, in the Name of God is Charlie Kirk's final message -- written in obedience, shaped by Scripture, and grounded in trust in the Lord. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

You hear from plenty of career politicians lately. That's not who I am.
I'm Mel Tull. I'm a business lawyer, a veteran, and a community leader. I've spent 30 years helping businesses grow, workers navigate challenges, and communities build something better. I've served as Treasurer of the Henrico Democratic Committee, doing the unglamorous work of building a stronger, more accountable party organization.
I didn't spend decades climbing the political ladder, waiting for my turn, or plotting my path to Congress. I got into this race because I'm fed up watching career politicians put their careers ahead of the people they're supposed to serve.
And I'm confident I can win this seat and bring a new kind of leadership — one that puts voters first, not politics.
Here's what that means in practice:
I'm not going to Washington to get rich. I've already built a career. I'm going to actually solve problems.
I'm not going to vote based on what's politically safe. I'm going to vote based on what's right for Virginia families.
I'm not going to spend my time grandstanding on cable news or chasing Twitter likes. I'm going to do the hard, boring work of legislating and delivering results.
Career politicians have made a mess of things. They've tripled their net worth while families struggle. They've voted to cut food stamps while padding their own bank accounts. They've attacked healthcare, undermined democracy, and sold out working people to wealthy donors and special interests.
That's what happens when you send career politicians to Congress. They serve themselves. They serve their party leadership. They serve their donors. But they don't serve you.
I bring a different kind of experience. Decades in the private sector working with businesses, workers, and nonprofits. Deep roots in Henrico and the Democratic Party. A focus on economic issues that families deal with every day — not culture war nonsense or partisan talking points.
We need leaders who've actually done something outside of politics. Leaders who understand how the economy works because they've lived in it, not just legislated about it. Leaders who will put voters first because that's what leadership actually means.
If you're tired of career politicians and ready for a different kind of leader in Congress, chip in $25, $50, $100, or more right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/melltull4congress]

name: Autism Health
subject: Join Us for Our Upcoming Fundraiser!
body:
Hearts & Vines Wine Tasting Fundraiser!

Please save the date for our Hearts & Vines Fundraiser, an elegant evening benefiting Autism Health Inc., proudly sponsored by Sunstone Winery (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/sunstonewinery.com/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/1/qhhyy1iFjB?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

If you are local to San Diego, please join us on Saturday, February 21st, from 5 PM to 9 PM PST in San Marcos, CA for a special night of community, connection, and purpose. Guests will enjoy fine wine, delicious hors d'oeuvres, and inspiring presentations from Dr. Sabine Hazan, (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/progenabiome.com/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/2/-Fs7hE6QAb?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID) Dr. Dayan Goodenowe (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/drgoodenowe.com/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/3/c9vDje9ozT?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID) , and Gabrielle Traub (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/www.sandiegohomeopathy.com%2Fstaff.htm/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/4/VmOvLTJlcX?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID) , who will share insights on fecal transplant, plasmalogens, homeopathy, autism, health, and the most up-to-date research.

Tickets are $95 and include wine, hors d'oeuvres, and a complimentary wine glass. There will also be a silent auction with amazing items to bid on.

This intimate fundraising event supports Autism Health Inc.’s mission to advance education, research, and resources for families impacted by autism and neurological disorders.

We look forward to sharing this meaningful evening with you!
REGISTER HERE (https://givebutter.com/2026_HnV?gbtid=f3ff79e2-33f6-4022-869c-2756e1795e1f&mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
------------------------------------------------------------

April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California

The Autism Health Summit is our flagship educational event, bringing together leading voices in research, medicine, advocacy, and integrative health for three powerful days of learning, connection, and collaboration. This annual gathering is designed for parents, practitioners, researchers, and advocates who are seeking deeper insight into autism and neurological health from a whole-body, whole-family perspective.

We are honored to welcome an extraordinary lineup of speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, Ed Clay, and many more respected experts and thought leaders. Together, they will explore cutting-edge research, clinical insights, environmental factors, and practical strategies that families and professionals can use. For a full list of speakers, click HERE to see our agenda (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fahsconference.com%252Fagenda%252F%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F1%2FeR-lkap3k2/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/6/Itz0aRhNPn?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

The Summit will be held at the beautiful Legacy Center Resort & Spa (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Flegacyresortandspa.com%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F2%2FcmuIWlIP_Q/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/7/L2iTF3yDUR?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID) , where attendees can book a room at a special group rate of $199 per night. To reserve your room, please use the conference room block link HERE (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fahsconference.com%252Fhotel%252F%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F3%2FR1Eh7nj6ve/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/8/waQ98Y-s90?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID) or call (619) 782-9155 and use block code: Autism26.

For the month of February only, we are offering a discount code Valentine50 to receive $50 off your in-person admission ticket. Don't miss out on this special offer!

We look forward to welcoming you to San Diego for an unforgettable weekend of education, empowerment, and community.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID)

We are deeply grateful to our top sponsors for their continued support and leadership: Cellular Performance Institute (CPI) (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fcellularperformanceinstitute.com%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F4%2FsxItfHHc49/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/10/I6UnIyEykc?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID) , Dr. Goodenowe Enterprises (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fdrgoodenowe.com%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F5%2F7zPRt-ypBb/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/11/xhNw8zSxyz?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID) , European Wellness (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Feuropean-wellness.eu%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F6%2FUZE-tepvnv/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/12/opfkF7ILLH?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID) , and Satellite Phone Store (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/satellitephonestore.com/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/13/Evqe0_cBgm?mc_cid=9e405b8517&mc_eid=UNIQID) . Warrior Mom: A Guidebook for Families

Warrior Mom: A Guidebook for Families on the Autism Journey

For many parents, the autism journey begins with questions, uncertainty, and the desire to find meaningful ways to support their child’s health and development. Warrior Mom: A Mother’s Journey in Healing Her Son with Autism was written to serve as a guidebook for families navigating that path. Through personal experience, practical insight, and years of research, the book offers encouragement and direction for parents seeking to better understand underlying health factors and whole-body approaches.

Families often share that the book helps them feel less alone while giving them tools to advocate, ask informed questions, and explore supportive strategies that may improve their child’s quality of life. It is not just a personal story, but a resource designed to empower parents with perspective, education, and hope as they move forward in caring for their loved ones on the spectrum.

Warrior Mom: A Mother’s Journey in Healing Her Son with Autism was written to serve as a guidebook for families navigating that path. Through personal experience, practical insight, and years of research, the book offers encouragement and direction for parents seeking to better understand underlying health factors and whole-body approaches. Families often share that the book helps them feel less alone while giving them tools to advocate, ask informed questions, and explore supportive strategies that may improve their child’s quality of life. It is not just a personal story, but a resource designed to empower parents with perspective, education, and hope as they move forward in caring for their loved ones on the spectrum. * **2025 Revisions Slash** : Annual benchmark adjustments cut 2025 job growth to only 181,000 from 584,000, revealing a much softer labor market last year.

# Bitcoin **plunges below 70K** amid wild volatility surge
Bitcoin's **[short-lived bounce from early February lows faded Wednesda](https://substack.com/redirect/2f681245-8814-4d60-ac30-ba473b102b02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** y as the cryptocurrency hovered around $66,000-$67,000, down roughly 4% intraday, continuing its downward slide from an October 2025 all-time high above $126,000.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2f681245-8814-4d60-ac30-ba473b102b02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Bear cycle prediction issued** : Analysts forecast 2026 as a "bear leg" in Bitcoin's four-year halving pattern, with potential drop to $50,000 by summer before fall recovery.
* **Liquidation wave triggered selloff** : A cascade of forced position closures on Feb. 5 intensified the decline, pushing Bitcoin briefly near $60,000 before partial rebound.
* **ETF flows show mixed signals** : Recent net inflows over three days offered some support, though broader outflows from Bitcoin ETFs added downward pressure earlier.
* **Cycle history remains intact** : Despite debates, experts say Bitcoin's post-halving pattern (last in April 2024) persists, with current volatility mirroring past bear phases after rallies.

# Bitcoin whales are using the crypto crash to buy Bitcoin at a discount
Bitcoin whales **[snapped up 53,000 coins last week--their biggest haul since November](https://substack.com/redirect/75321e46-28e8-46a1-b2b8-b5f5d72c01a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**--providing crucial price support near $70,000 after a sharp drop to $60,000, even as retail and institutional investors largely retreated amid ongoing volatility and uncertainty over broader recovery.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/75321e46-28e8-46a1-b2b8-b5f5d72c01a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Whale accumulation surges** : Wallets with over 1,000 BTC added more than $4 billion worth in the past week, reversing recent heavy selling and marking the largest weekly purchase since November.
* **Longer-term selling trend** : Large holders excluding ETFs and exchanges have been net sellers for the past year, offloading over 170,000 coins valued at about $11 billion since mid-December.
* **Price stabilization role** : The whale buying slowed Bitcoin's downfall and fueled a rebound from last week's lows, but experts say sustained rallies need fresh inflows from other sources.
* **Demand doubts persist** : With ETF investors nursing losses and corporate buyers pausing, analysts view the whale activity more as short-term damage control than strong conviction for a lasting bull run.

# Robinhood stock craters on brutal Q4 revenue miss
Robinhood shares **[plunged more than 12% in early trading Wednesday](https://substack.com/redirect/21f670b2-dec0-4dad-bee5-a9fb48bf37a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the brokerage reported fourth-quarter revenue that missed Wall Street's forecast amid a crypto slowdown and weaker transaction volumes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/21f670b2-dec0-4dad-bee5-a9fb48bf37a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Revenue shortfall stings** : Q4 revenue hit $1.28 billion, short of $1.35 billion estimates, dragging shares down sharply despite full-year record $4.5 billion in 2025.
* **Crypto revenue tumbles** : Crypto trading brought in $221 million, below $248 million expected, reflecting broader market weakness and a 38% year-over-year drop in some reports.
* **Options trading disappoints** : Options revenue reached $314 million versus $331 million anticipated, contributing to the overall transaction-based shortfall.
* **Diversification cushions blow** : Despite misses, analysts note stronger positioning through subscriptions, banking, and prediction markets for potential recovery in 2026.

# Banks slam Stablecoin yields at White House Crypto showdown
Major US banks, led by JPMorgan and Bank of America, **[intensified their push against stablecoin interest payments](https://substack.com/redirect/9913c448-d69a-4f61-bac1-6f990f0acf8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during a tense White House meeting Tuesday, demanding strict bans to protect deposits and lending as the Clarity Act crypto bill stays stalled in Congress amid industry clashes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9913c448-d69a-4f61-bac1-6f990f0acf8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Banks Demand Strict Ban:** Major banks circulated a document prohibiting any interest or rewards on stablecoin holdings, with only narrow exemptions to prevent deposit flight from traditional accounts.
* **White House Hosts Clash:** Tuesday's meeting by the White House crypto council featured heated discussions between banking groups and crypto representatives like Coinbase, but yielded no resolution on yield rules.
* **Clarity Act Faces Delay:** The broader market structure bill remains frozen in the Senate due to unresolved disputes over stablecoin rewards, despite the GENIUS Act's prior stablecoin framework signed last summer.
* **Joint Industry Statement Issued:** Banking associations emphasized embracing innovation while safeguarding bank deposits that fund Main Street lending, calling for strong enforcement and a future study on payment stablecoins.

* * *
# Kraft Heinz halts dramatic split, new CEO declares challenges "Fixable"
Kraft Heinz **[abruptly paused its planned breakup into two companies Wednesday](https://substack.com/redirect/b837a618-1863-4b8e-8674-67589d415cd9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as new CEO Steve Cahillane argued the food giant's persistent issues are fixable internally, redirecting focus and $600 million toward a U.S. turnaround amid ongoing sales struggles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b837a618-1863-4b8e-8674-67589d415cd9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **New CEO 's Bold Pivot:** Steve Cahillane, who started in January after leading Kellogg's split, deems most problems "fixable and within our control" and prioritizes profitable growth over separation.
* **Major Investment Announced:** The company will allocate $600 million to boost marketing, sales, R&D, product superiority, and selective pricing to revive its lagging U.S. business.
* **Split Background Reversal:** Plans announced in September 2025 to divide the post-2015 merger entity are halted to avoid dis-synergies this year and refocus resources on operations.
* **Market and Analyst Reaction:** Shares dipped as much as 5% initially but stabilized; some analysts view the pause negatively, seeing it as a sign the businesses aren't ready for standalone operation yet.

Nancy Mace stood alongside Epstein survivors today and called for the immediate release of all unredacted Epstein files | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/nancymace/i-read-the-epstein-files?e=ddc57b5ede)

| | **Friend,** This week, I stood alongside Epstein survivors and read the unredacted files at the Department of Justice. **What I found was deeply troubling.** Documents about co-conspirators were heavily redacted or missing entirely from the database. Names that should be public are still being protected. But here's what I can tell you: I have more names today than I had yesterday. And I'm putting together a list of people I want interviewed by the House Oversight Committee.
---
| [Support Nancy Mace](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=cd007330b5&e=ddc57b5ede "Support Nancy Mace")
---
|
---
| **Why I’m on A Mission For Transparency** For thousands of years, women have been treated as second-class citizens. From the Book of Genesis when Dinah was assaulted and the powerful tried to sweep it under the rug, to today - the pattern is the same. I know what it's like to be dismissed. To report abuse and watch nothing happen. To see the powerful protected while survivors are left behind. Two years ago, I went to law enforcement with evidence on a silver platter. To this day, not a single person has been arrested. Not a single person is in jail. That's why I'm fighting for Epstein's survivors. Their stories are true. Their stories are real. Their trauma is lifelong. And I’m standing with them for truth and justice for all.
---
| [Read The Files](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=226a044c93&e=ddc57b5ede "Read The Files")
---
|
---
| **A Message to Survivors** The world is watching and we must show them what we’re made of. We are made of your courage. We are made of your bravery. We are made of your truth. Judges across this country are revealing the names and addresses of rape victims. Survivors who come forward are being sued by their abusers. This isn't just happening to Epstein's victims - it's happening to women and children everywhere. We either stand with children or we stand against them. There is no middle ground here. America has a two-tiered system of justice: one for the rich and powerful, and one for the rest of us. Those days are numbered. I want the princes, the former presidents, the billionaires to know: your days are numbered. As Governor, I'll make sure every predator stays behind bars. When it comes to fighting voter suppression, our work is never done. Increasing participation in free and fair elections that are accessible to ALL eligible voters is our #1 goal for 2026, Team.
Unfortunately, this is what we're facing as we start the year:
➜ Mail-in voting is under threat in state legislatures and now from the Supreme Court.
➜ Without vote-by-mail, millions of Americans will not be able to vote.
➜ With the 2026 midterm election around the corner, this is a disaster.
Remember, Team: Attacks on mail-in voting are voter suppression, plain and simple. We need your help now, more than ever. Will you chip in $35 to protect vote-by-mail before it’s too late? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=021126_1&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=021126_1&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=021126_1&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=021126_1&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=021126_1&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=021126_1&amount=250] Other Amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=021126_1&amount=35]
As voters across the country face unprecedented barriers at the ballot box , our fight to defend voting rights continues.
From educating voters on rapidly changing election laws -- like USPS changing the postmark rules -- to ensuring voters have the tools they need to make their voices heard this year, Voter Action Project will continue to stand strong in defense of voters in need, which is why we rely on early support from this team.
We have the momentum , but we have to keep doing the work to keep it going until November.
We’re working overtime to solidify our plans to fight back and ensure every American can cast a ballot in 2026. Can you chip in $35 to support our work today? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=021126_1&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
https://www.facebook.com/voteraction [https://www.facebook.com/voteraction] https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org [https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org] https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/ [https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/] https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/ [https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/]
Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=021126_1&amount=20]
Donate Now [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=021126_1&amount=20]

subject: Undeniable Momentum🚀
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MARK SMITH FOR CONGRESS
body:
Voters aren’t looking for slogans. They’re looking for results... | | | | [ ](https://VoteMarkSmith.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75ca839227bb28c57ff73dffe&id=81478cd70a&e=d4051626af)
---
| | | **Dear Friend,** Over the past few weeks, I’ve been traveling across the Lowcountry, meeting with voters, small business owners, veterans, and families who are tired of politicians who talk big but don’t deliver. **They’re not asking for speeches.
They’re asking for results.** That’s exactly what I’ve focused on in the State House — and it’s why our campaign for Congress continues to build real momentum. _Here's an update from the campaign trail!_
* * *
**📺 NEW TV AD LAUNCHED** This week, we launched our new television ad highlighting the results we’ve delivered in the State House — and the kind of leadership I’ll bring to Washington. In Columbia, I helped pass the largest tax cut in South Carolina history.
I led the charge to eliminate state income taxes on military retirement pay. And I secured over **$1 billion** to fix crowded roads and modernize infrastructure across the Lowcountry. That’s not rhetoric. That’s _results._ [](https://VoteMarkSmith.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75ca839227bb28c57ff73dffe&id=abdfa7707d&e=d4051626af)
[click to play](https://VoteMarkSmith.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75ca839227bb28c57ff73dffe&id=22bb0eb2eb&e=d4051626af)
* * *
**🏆 STRAW POLL VICTORY** Monday night, we won the Beaufort County Republican straw poll with **50% of the vote****, up from 38% last year.** It’s a strong sign that conservatives across the Lowcountry are ready for proven leadership — and ready to win.
* * *
**📈 MOMENTUM IS REAL** Since launching this campaign:
* We’ve earned over **70 endorsements from CD1 elected officials and leaders — by far the most in the field**
* We’ve held more public meetings and events than any other candidate
* We’ve raised the most organic grassroots dollars in the race

Voters aren’t looking for slogans. They’re looking for results — and that’s exactly what we’re offering.
* * *
**🌴 LOWCOUNTRY FIRST** As a fourth-generation Lowcountry native, small business owner, husband, and father, I believe public service means delivering real results for the people you represent. That’s how I’ve served in the State House — and it’s how I’ll serve you in Congress. **The Republican Primary is June 9. We’re working every day to earn every vote — and I’m grateful to have you with us.**
---

We’re stepping up — and together, we’re going to win. Gratefully,
State Rep. Mark Smith

When he censured me and threatened my rank and retirement, he came after what I earned over 25 years — and chilled the free speech rights of every retired member of the military alongside me. If Hegseth isn’t stopped, our longest-serving military veterans will have to live with the constant threat that they could be deprived of their rank and pension years — even decades — after they leave the military if they say something he doesn’t like. name: LeftNet
subject: Stand with Minnesota
body:
[1]LeftNet

After over a month of chaos, Minnesota is still under occupation by
federal agents from ICE and CBP, and communities across Minnesota need
your support.

Federal agents continue to stop, harass, and detain people regardless of
their citizenship status. Normal life has been interrupted. Schools have
been forced to close or go virtual. Many people are living in fear of
leaving their homes, and some have even stopped going to work.

Minnesotans are organizing and mobilizingto respond to this crisis. But
they need our help.

Stand with Minnesota has a directory of places, people, and organizations
to donate to, compiled directly by activists on the ground who are plugged
into what families in the community need most right now.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/22306?source=em20260211-1502&t=1001&akid=1502%2E2118727%2EpokxFB ]If you want to help families sheltering in place, pay for someone’s
groceries, essential household items, safe home drop-offs, and help with
rent and monthly bills, please visit Stand with Minnesota’s website here.

If you cannot donate, that is okay! Please share these links or forward
this email to friends, family, and your networks. Amplifying what is
happening in Minnesota makes a difference, too.

In solidarity,

LeftNet

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.leftnet.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1502%2E2118727%2EpokxFB

I want to hear from you.
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4069%2E898137%2EH3vrAL)
Friend,
Growing up, running for office was never on my radar.
But now that I’m here, I’ve learned so much — and I’m eager to share with you what goes on behind the scenes. Whether it’s through a chat over a beer on our brewery tour, Instagram Live updates, or your inbox, I want you involved in the journey, discovering alongside me how we can make a real impact.
One thing you may have picked up is that this isn’t your typical email program. **I want this to be more than just me telling you what I think matters — I want to know what you care about.**
**This is a team.** One of the most important things to me on this team is building trust. I made the decision at the outset of this campaign that we’re not taking any corporate PAC donations, knowing that was going to make it _much_ harder to fundraise.
I’m also not listening to a billionaire boys club tell us what we should prioritize and how we should build policy. _I want that to be driven by you._
**[My campaign has put together a winter priorities survey to learn more about what matters most to you. Your voice helps shape our priorities as we begin this critical election year. So, will you take a moment to fill out this survey?](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/survey/2602-issues-survey?refcode=AU_MAM_EG_GEN_SUR_AC_20260211_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=4069%2E898137%2EH3vrAL)**

subject: We can’t let them win.
body:
Peter,
I wanted to emphasize just how serious of a moment we are in.
Donald Trump’s federal agents are going door to door in Minnesota looking for folks based on their accent or color of their skin. Kids are afraid to go to school, small businesses are hurting, another life has been lost, and the people responsible have yet to be held accountable. Instead, Donald Trump’s DOJ is investigating me.
Why? Because my focus has always been protecting the people of Minnesota.
They’re trying to scare me and our state — but Minnesota will not be intimidated into silence and neither will I. This legal battle will be expensive, that’s why they’re doing this. They want me to back down and surrender, but I won’t.

Peter, it's Mark.

I am suing the Secretary of Defense.

After 25 years in uniform and another 5 in the United States Senate, I never imagined I’d have to do something like this. Hegseth has left me no choice.

Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth want to use the power of the White House and the Department of Defense to punish me because they don’t like what I have to say. Their attacks are directed at me right now, but they’re trying to send a message to every retired member of the military:

Speak out against us and we will come after you with every tool we have at our disposal. We’ll censure you, we’ll threaten your rank and retirement, and we might even court-martial you.

It’s unconstitutional, so I’m suing them. Beyond this lawsuit, it’s important we send a message to Trump and Hegseth to show them just how many people are on this team to defend constitutional rights. That’s where you come in.

I’ve been truly humbled by the support people have sent my way over the past couple of months. It means the world to me that so many of you care about what Trump and Hegseth are trying to do.

# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=542%2E124072%2EmcY-B5)
Peter, our ask is simple: **We’re less than 12 hours out** from our FEC pre-primary filing deadline. **We're SO close** to 10,000 grassroots donors. If everyone reading this email — _yes, you!_ — gave $3 RIGHT NOW, we'd hit our goal long before midnight. _But this only works if you're part of it._ **[So we’re asking directly: Can Roy count on you to chip in $3 _right now_ before tonight’s deadline?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5429?t=7&akid=542%2E124072%2EmcY-B5)** When we file our public filing deadline report at midnight, everyone from our opponents to the news media will hyperanalyze it to judge whether Roy has what it takes to flip this seat. I want to acknowledge the anger, fear, and frustration that so many of us feel right now. I also want to share a few thoughts. | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvmfuXmYYW_FOYjb_3v61emWuNXO-wS3-aHqPhXdS_0AOJubYzSqDcubjA-pAHVBC87_XW0v_Yj-7XBxFQdfvbTote4rd4-pSpW07ywkKltv5Jlyw6Mt11o7Pqa63jROGG0WPT9ay6JOjgymT9fNzZDvX4h0v8yZUSCfBGKfhio6Nh0OMU67wlz05IDoYbT8U8kNPTi9s9th5P3ADJICRvWXdEOiu8S0Gu3KFj3Da1l5GBh4lSrnS2DbkoKi36Vu5GPX9rqVoYX2v2IBUTv_LYOXNsBPmeVFIyL6EG06oS0B__oKgksTFz_kEkndRJQiVwOrxEdgrRStOFBfPF9aVMLYnrpkVuDALF9nAoCq2nVTUnFkEPt2NPFW9S_N9ODNudaNJs1VXzB0QvqTnsHW2tnUtzDUXxSYaldF8145gV8N4RkymeDCbox2lJT_0o3BRY/4o2/ltpKo8xBQmqF4pbwvVjaTw/h0/h001.JSiXhHNqCrHgCKRBKqTFbY38aFKYPcHDv6tk4nO-cK4)

Hi Peter,

I know many of us are horrified by what’s happening in Minneapolis and across our country. People are scared. Families are worried. We’re watching in real time as ICE, CBP, and other federal agencies routinely violate our rights and endanger our neighbors.

I want to acknowledge the anger, fear, and frustration that so many of us feel right now. I also want to share a few thoughts:

1. People – regardless of immigration status or how federal authorities choose to define them – are in danger when ICE operates this way.

Any agent entrusted with the authority to use lethal force must be able to withstand criticism, noise, and public scrutiny without resorting to deadly violence.

This administration is pursuing reckless enforcement policies and refusing to course-correct, even when public safety is at stake.

**That is unacceptable.**

2. Turning local law enforcement into ICE agents makes communities less safe.

Local law enforcement’s job is to keep our communities safe. They are not employed to carry out Trump’s federal immigration agenda.

When neighbors are afraid to call 911 or report crimes because they fear deportation, everyone becomes more vulnerable.

In Milwaukee County, we have longstanding policies prohibiting cooperation with ICE detainer requests. **As governor, I will reject policies that distract local law enforcement from their duty to keep communities safe.**

3. When it comes to Wisconsin’s next governor, we need someone who will fight strategically.

That means electing a candidate who is more interested in results than headlines – and who would rather get the facts straight than disseminate inaccurate information during times of crisis.

On the Republican side, Tom Tiffany has already promised that if he were elected Governor, ICE presence in Wisconsin would be similar to what we’ve seen in Minnesota over the past few weeks. That is unacceptable.

**As governor, I will put people first, defend local control, and refuse to let fear-based enforcement define public safety in our state._[If that’s a vision you can get behind, I hope you’ll chip in $5 or whatever you can afford to power our campaign and help us defeat Tom Tiffany.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvNEXIpkCg6lBN8hsEGmRwC4vV7Q5K_z6JUNz_ykeoRP4ZSV-k95YNKJ8DiGsqRgWpH0XdbVan2PuQRRohtYbC0tchTGTw1KbDEOv1rwOP3g1STusFYpHVRCGrrrvshc_iygHEiT96pdbamOZiutujBjf7tpdXz94BF8EYcSoO-G_qOIj-oj-HIkonsTqV_kDTspRPdRoN0EJbvX3Zp1FEfapBKejyMX46jNTmU4K_elEQxqQ3nxGRlT-tVu9vS5ag_9Mhrozb86FaAC_w8q2uEellqjhdjNuso06TuddFjKw_uC7j49o0JVbO-_9uTsOs5ldXVTv6YdIIDeXXk36Jkv_WUs2e3fCPmUuVBSZQj59Oun2d_bJnYklIur9Rokf4IDbV8XtkK9xbKMubxOoa7DG75anUX2RkzRUp23QRqHKKiHoJRMpagMIYq1TiYEcQ/4o2/ltpKo8xBQmqF4pbwvVjaTw/h1/h001.6mq-0bGdXgQEk4tYpKNGpisSV3d7xLhFudntYXhB9cc)_** [Donate now »](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvNEXIpkCg6lBN8hsEGmRwC4vV7Q5K_z6JUNz_ykeoRP4ZSV-k95YNKJ8DiGsqRgWqBXn8ZPmgwSP2U_4yuYhl1TA2UEFfjsnIX7G-L9Nr5giy-d4om4ZSl2QzVzbYOt2Q32D7028so9gkJBtpydq8WbTFVDI1JSISJSNGLrT0tRQB4QPEsKgZ7EOU_J_Uu-5DxHUWDUTK7sWSLzwIltygn5BIJR4nsOYHE6jzqvVK_IW8HdXw-0b7gIgOyk8niVbxaNiM4cOfoJ4iSSHui2glZ5Wvlp51dPVqx5MyuF5_rZ9RNJSN-dxYE5lFlkvQ7mTx44oxYzEGYEw4SBvWrrsHrBVLRIH4RzXGob8IvowsXccP3WiXiAOTzWGpzZ1sTV-9J09bXSrzccmYq-lxa1Ps5ZN41P5aaK8Mtu5tziMBiMgeoQGLWxKR16PpLghPTrbI/4o2/ltpKo8xBQmqF4pbwvVjaTw/h2/h001.B3h3ufXAMVQolst3rCB3OXYjypyLLrQSJ8QMwxv8pCE) Peter: When public safety, rather than political point-scoring, is the top priority, everybody wins.

body:
We’re raising $10,000 before February 15 to move this campaign forward.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/131?refcode=em20260211-160&t=1&akid=160%2E12592%2EYWdDWB)
We’re reaching out with an important update as this campaign moves into a critical phase.
To keep our momentum going, Virginians for Fair Elections needs to raise $10,000 by February 15. Reaching this goal allows us to take the next major step in our campaign — and we need your help to get there.
Reaching this goal allows us to:
* Launch our first round of digital ads
* Get voter education and outreach materials in front of Virginians across the Commonwealth
* Build momentum early _before_ this amendment goes before voters in April

These efforts are how we make sure Virginians get clear, accurate information about the redistricting referendum — and what this amendment actually protects: **fair elections, and real representation.**
That clarity matters right now.
As MAGA Republicans begin funneling money into misinformation campaigns designed to confuse voters and distort the truth, we need strong grassroots support to make sure voters hear the facts first. Acting early gives us the best chance to cut through the noise before confusion takes hold.
This moment matters.
Passing this amendment protects Virginia’s elections by putting power where it belongs — in the hands of voters, not politicians operating behind closed doors. By allowing Virginians to review congressional maps before elections take place, this amendment levels the playing field and restores fairness in our elections.
To hold that ground and protect our democracy, we need your help.
[**If you’re able, please chip in whatever you can today to help us reach our $10,000 mid-month goal and keep this YES on fair elections campaign moving forward.**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260211_1.lsrhdO&amount=3&refcode=20260211-160&t=2&akid=160%2E12592%2EYWdDWB)

Fair elections don’t protect themselves — **_people do._**

Virginians for Fair Elections

body:
Mandated hiring preferences are not a “just transition”
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
The questions are pouring in — and they’re not softballs.
Coloradans are asking about constitutional overreach, Second Amendment protections, election integrity, immigration enforcement, TABOR, AI policy, and whether state laws are crossing the line. **They want to know who will stand up, who will push back, and how candidates plan to actually govern — not just campaign.** That’s exactly why we’re hosting this forum.
In partnership with Southwest Republican Women and the La Plata County Republican Central Committee, RMV is bringing Republican candidates directly to voters at the **[Colorado Republican Candidate Forum](https://link.email.joinrmv.) in Durango on Feb. 13** — and we’re opening the floor statewide.
**If there’s something keeping you up at night, this is your chance to put it on the stage.**
👉 **Submit your question[here](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Under the Golden Dome...** [Budget writers paused](https://link.email.joinrmv.) proposed Medicaid caregiver pay cuts after emotional testimony, even as officials warned the program’s soaring costs—now about a third of the state budget—remain a key driver of Colorado’s $1 billion shortfall. Lawmakers are also weighing mandatory prison sentences for certain [sex crimes against minors](https://link.email.joinrmv.), drawing support from prosecutors and trafficking survivors while critics warn of unintended consequences.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** In Denver, the school board is considering limits on school resource officers [arresting or ticketing undocumented students](https://link.email.joinrmv.), sparking debate over accountability and safety. Cherry Creek Schools announced [an external audit](https://link.email.joinrmv.) after leadership turmoil triggered by investigative reporting, while a U.S. Marshals-led task force [cleared 566 felony warrants](https://link.email.joinrmv.) in 2025—a 17% jump—marking intensified efforts to apprehend violent fugitives statewide.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** A [national superintendent group](https://link.email.joinrmv.) hosted a private webinar outlining how schools should respond to potential ICE enforcement, raising concerns about coordination against federal authorities. Meanwhile, [nearly 100 conservative leaders](https://link.email.joinrmv.) are urging Senate leadership to pass the SAVE America Act—even via talking filibuster—arguing citizenship verification and photo ID are essential election safeguards.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** One Colorado analysis argues crime isn’t just about statutes [but justice-system discretion](https://link.email.joinrmv.), warning SB26-036’s “prison population management” could accelerate releases and weaken accountability. Another defends capitalism as the [proven driver of human flourishing](https://link.email.joinrmv.) over socialism’s centralized control. Closer to home, a piece cautions that “[just transition” hiring mandates](https://link.email.joinrmv.) amount to state-directed workforce policy, while a historical reflection revisits a century-old warning that [without secure borders and assimilation](https://link.email.joinrmv.), national cohesion erodes.
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, February 11, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Mandated hiring preferences are not a “just transition”](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY AIMEE TOOKER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
_The[Colorado Just Transition Action Plan](https://link.email.joinrmv.) was established in 2020 to “empower communities with resources to drive their own economic transitions.” I take personal issue with Section 2 of this introduced bill._
_[SB26-052](https://link.email.joinrmv.) “CONCERNING COAL TRANSITION COMMUNITIES, AND, IN CONNECTION THEREWITH, PROVIDING A HIRING PREFERENCE FOR COAL TRANSITION WORKERS IN COAL TRANSITION COMMUNITIES AND EXPANDING THE ALLOWABLE WAYS IN WHICH A PUBLIC ENTITY MAY DEPOSIT OR INVEST JUST TRANSITION MONEY.”_ _· A COVERED BUSINESS**SHALL** **CONSULT** WITH THE JUST TRANSITION OFFICE,_ _· A COVERED BUSINESS**SHALL** **REPORT ANNUALLY** TO THE JUST TRANSITION OFFICE THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION REGARDING THE PRIOR YEAR:_ _o (a) THE TITLE OF ANY POSITION FILLED BY A QUALIFIED COAL TRANSITION WORKER;_ _o (b) THE NUMBER OF QUALIFIED COAL TRANSITION WORKERS WHO FILLED POSITIONS AT THE COVERED BUSINESS;_ _o (c) THE NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS WHO ARE NOT QUALIFIED COAL TRANSITION WORKERS WHO FILLED POSITIONS AT THE COVERED BUSINESS;_ _o (d) EFFORTS UNDERTAKEN BY THE COVERED BUSINESS TO RECRUIT QUALIFIED COAL TRANSITION WORKERS_
_A “Just Transition” was “**to help each community end up with more family-sustaining jobs, a broader property tax base, and measurably more economic diversity.”**_
_The State of Colorado mandating who can have a job is a slippery slope and I for one appreciate the intent, but I take issue with the mandating reporting for the hiring preference._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[Colorado task force clears 566 felony warrants as fugitive arrests rise in 2025](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **566 felony warrants cleared in 2025 — fugitive arrests rise 17% statewide** – A U.S. Marshals-led task force arrested 498 fugitives and cleared more warrants than the previous year, signaling intensified efforts to track down violent offenders across Colorado.
* **Front Range sees bulk of enforcement, including homicide and violent crime suspects** – Twenty of those apprehended were wanted for homicide or attempted homicide, with many others tied to serious offenses spanning multiple jurisdictions.
* **Multi-agency cooperation targets criminals crossing city and state lines** – The Colorado Violent Offender Task Force combines federal, state, and local resources to close enforcement gaps and prevent fugitives from exploiting jurisdictional boundaries.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[“America must not be overwhelmed”: A century-old warning revisited](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY TOM ANTHONY, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* _**A century-old warning resurfaces in today’s immigration debate** — The commentary revisits early 20th-century arguments that America “must not be overwhelmed,” drawing parallels between past immigration surges and current concerns about border security and national cohesion._
* _**Historical cycles show policy consequences, not just rhetoric** — The piece connects labor tensions, demographic shifts, and political backlash from previous eras to modern debates over enforcement, sovereignty, and economic strain._
* _**The core argument: sovereignty and assimilation matter** — The author contends that without enforceable borders and cultural integration, large-scale migration can strain institutions, weaken shared identity, and destabilize public trust._

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Colorado’s crime problem is bigger than the laws on the books](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** **BY CORY GAINES | COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 10** _As I’ve written before, our troubles with crime involve more than just the laws on the books. There are a few steps in the criminal justice process where someone has discretion. Discretion means the ability to be too hard, or too soft. District Attorneys decide on whether to charge and what charges to bring. Judges decide on bail, and the trial judge passes sentence. Each step a chance to be too harsh or too easy._
[**Open letter warns HB26-1065 expands unelected power and state control**](https://link.email.joinrmv.) **BY CORY GAINES | COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 9** _In keeping with earlier posts, I have been watching affordable housing legislation this session. One of the bills that came up in an earlier post is HB26-1065. I link to that bill first below. Mild in the impact, especially compared with efforts that take away local control and further reinforce the NGO/nonprofit/government complex, this bill is still concerning in what it sets up._
[**No Man’s Land: Surrendering Self at the Cross**](https://link.email.joinrmv.) **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 8** _In response to concerns raised by a family in Colorado about the treatment of their young son in kindergarten, the Office for Civil Rights of the U.S. Department of Education opened an investigation into whether the Cherry Creek School District was in compliance with federal civil rights and special education law, a problem that is not new to the district._

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).
|

|
---
⚖️ **DID YOU KNOW?** With roughly **10 million arrests each year in the U.S.** , millions of bail and pretrial release decisions are made annually — and about 60% of people in local jails haven’t been convicted yet, meaning judicial discretion shapes public safety outcomes for hundreds of thousands of cases every single day.
|

Peter,
What I am about to say should alarm every single one of us.
At the tail end of January, journalists and protesters, including Don Lemon, Georgia Fort, Trahern Crews, and Jamael Lundy , were arrested while covering and participating in an anti-immigration enforcement protest at a Minnesota church.
These individuals were arrested for reporting, protesting, and exercising their First Amendment rights.
This is not about public safety; it’s intimidation, and it’s an attack on free speech.
Time and again, this administration has shown us exactly who ICE protects, and it’s sure not our communities. ICE terrorizes immigrants, brutalizes protesters, and now targets journalists for telling the truth.
Hands off our rights. Hands off our communities. SIGN OUR PETITION TODAY AND DEMAND THE ABOLITION OF ICE. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4qRlc8gFxUy7i7fuM0mE1w2]
Meanwhile, my opponent, Wesley Bell, is doing what establishment Democrats always do when ICE crosses the line:
✅ Lip service & empty statements.
✅ Calling for "investigation" of ICE with no real follow-through.
✅ Claiming that more training for ICE will solve this.
He isn’t :
❌ Calling the ICE killings what they are: executions.
❌ Calling for ICE to be abolished.
I will.
Because you don’t reform an agency built on cruelty. You don’t “train” your way out of state violence. You ABOLISH ICE and build systems rooted in dignity, safety, and human rights.
Add your name to my petition right now demanding ICE be abolished and our First Amendment rights be protected. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4qRlc8gFxUy7i7fuM0mE1w2]
SIGN ON NOW [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4qRlc8gFxUy7i7fuM0mE1w2]
This movement is about telling the truth and fighting for our people.
In solidarity,
Cori Bush

| | | Hi Peter, I had a full-on elections nerd moment this week 🤓 — and I need you to stick with me for a minute. Donald Trump recently said that “Republicans ought to nationalize the voting.” In other words: put the federal government in control of elections instead of the states. Even if you think he’s bluffing... the rhetoric itself is dangerous and here’s why: **Most political change doesn’t start with passing a law. It starts with shifting what can be said without pushback. There’s a name for this:****the Overton Window: the range of ideas that feel acceptable to debate in public policy.** At any given moment, ideas move from:
Unthinkable → Radical → Acceptable → Popular → Policy. You don’t need votes to move that window. You move it by repeating extreme ideas until they stop sounding extreme. Before, Trump disputed results claiming that “Democrats cheated” even when evidence said it didn’t. Now, he’s disputing who should run elections.That’s not just complaining about an outcome.That’s claiming new authority. And once the conversation shifts from, “Should this ever happen?” to “How would it work?” We’ve already lost ground. Democratic norms don’t erode overnight. They erode through repetition. Through normalization. Through desensitization — especially when there’s so much chaos that people stop reacting. **Democracy isn’t protected by laws alone. It’s protected by people who understand the rules and are willing to name what’s happening.** That’s why I’m running for Secretary of State. I’m the only candidate in this race who has actually administered elections, and I’ve done so for nearly half a million voters. I’ve written voting rights laws. I’ve defended vote-by-mail. And I know exactly what’s at stake if extremists try to undermine state control of our elections. But here’s the truth: protecting Colorado’s gold-standard election system is going to take resources. A rigged system where Republicans can lose the popular vote by millions and still control Congress. A democracy where the will of the people is crushed under the weight of partisan maps drawn in backrooms by MAGA operatives.

If we don't use every single card in the book while MAGA ramps up their attacks, we guarantee that Democrats will never retake the House. Not in 2026. Not in 2028. Not for a generation.

| | Friends, Again: 1) check out David’s recent issue statements below; and 2) one last pitch to solicit your help in collecting signatures to place David on Maine’s Democratic primary ballot. The process is straightforward. Anyone in Maine can collect signatures and any **registered Democrat**(in Maine) can sign a petition. If you’re interested in helping, we’ll provide you with blank 8.5-inch by 14-inch petition form(s) and information on where (almost anywhere) and how to collect signatures. We need to collect 2,000 signatures by March 16 to qualify for the June ballot. There are any number of ways and places or events to utilize to collect signatures (e.g., Trump resistance protests and other similar activities, busy downtowns, and, conveniently, the Maine Democratic Party’s Feb. 28 and March 1 municipal caucuses). If you are interested in helping, please let us know by emailing us at [campaign@costelloforsenate.com](mailto:campaign@costelloforsenate.com) or David directly at costellodavida37@gmail.com. Thank you and best,Team Costello P.S. A few of David’s recent issue statements: **Nuclear Arms Control** What does Senator Susan Collins have to say? Today marks the expiration of the last NUCLEAR ARMS CONTROL treaty between the US and Russia. Leaving both nations with no limits on the size or structure of their arsenals for the first time since 1972; at the very moment both are planning new generations of nuclear weapons and delivery systems. And frighteningly, at a time when our anti-immigration and self-dealing and promotion crazed presidential administration is focused elsewhere. Along with addressing America’s unsolved affordability challenges – (which could be addressed by enacting Medicare for all and universal childcare, and investing more in retirement security, education, and housing, and funding these efforts via increased taxes on the wealthy) – we need the Trump Administration to prioritize nuclear disarmament negotiations and agreements. Adding more, particularly non-recallable missiles, to ours’s and our potential adversaries’ (Russia, China and North Korea) nuclear arsenals, as is currently underway, is not the sanest way forward. We should instead, along with our allies (UK and France) and other nuclear powers (India, Pakistan and Isreal), be working to advance global disarmament treaties that center on replacing the concept of mutually assured destruction (MAD) with that of minimally assured deterrence (i.e., the idea of nuclear armed nations’ having just enough nuclear weapons to deter advisories, but nowhere near enough collectively to wipe out humanity)... And while they’re at, the world’s nuclear powers should also consider doing a lot more to mitigate humanities' other potential existential threats: climate change and unconstrained artificial intelligence (AI)... **Money’s Corrupting Influence on Politics and Government** What does Senator Collins have to say? MONEY has forever had a corrupting influence on American politics and government, and its deleterious impact has never been more evident than is the case today. It poisons our democracy in that it obliterates political equality, a fundamental tenant of democracy, by drowning out ordinary voices and skewing government actions in favor of wealthy individuals and corporations and eroding the public’s trust in government. One only needs to see evidence of the recent flood of super PAC spending and “dark money” to understand the harmful extent to which money, and money funded mis- and dis-information, has over our politics and government. To remedy this situation, we should ratify the “For Our Freedom Amendment,” which would allow Congress and the states to lessen the influence of excessive “dark” and other campaign funding; establish a public financing program for US House and Senate campaigns; and create an independent, nonpartisan Federal Elections and Ethics Commission with strong oversight and enforcement authority to oversee elections, governmental ethics, and campaign financing. Additionally, aside from tackling the corrupting influence of money, we should also consider other elections related reforms, like: modernizing our nation’s voting infrastructure; mandating automatic voter registration, early voting, and no-excuse voting by mail; banning unreasonable voter purges, deceptive politicking, and partisan gerrymandering; expanding civics education mandates and programs; funding journalistically ethical, non-profit news organizations; and enacting social media regulations that oblige social media platforms to adhere to strict privacy, anti-violence incitement, and fact-based public interest information rules. It’s well past time that we did more, a lot more to fix our imperfect democracy and government... **Senator Collins Needs to Stand Up to Trump or Step Aside** Democracy requires that we stand up and speak out... That said, Senator Susan Collins needs to employ what diminishing leverage she has over the federal government’s budget process to end the secret police-state style tactics being utilized by the Trump Administration in Maine, MN, and elsewhere to scare, demonize, and round-up immigrants and to harm lawful protestors. Having failed earlier to thwart enactment of the President’s Big Ugly Bill, which cut healthcare and child nutrition programs to fund tax cuts for America’s wealthiest; block the nominations of highly unqualified department heads (e.g., Pete Hegseth, Kristi Noem, Robert Kennedy, Lee Zeldin, and Linda McMahon); and mitigate such harmful foreign policy actions as favoring Russia over Ukraine, dismantling USAID and eviscerating the State Department, and undermining critical economic and environmental agreements and security alliances – – Senator Collins needs to either step up and stand up to the Trump Administration or step aside... Expressions of concern aren’t sufficient...

With your support, we can reach 2,000 and give voters a real choice. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Friends, Again: 1) check out David’s recent issue statements below; and 2) one last pitch to solicit your help in collecting signatures to place David on Maine’s Democratic primary ballot. The process is straightforward. Anyone in Maine can collect signatures and any registered Democrat(in Maine) can sign a petition. If you’re interested in helping, we’ll provide you with blank 8.5-inch by 14-inch petition form(s) and information on where (almost anywhere) and how to collect signatures. We need to collect 2,000 signatures by March 16 to qualify for the June ballot. There are any number of ways and places or events to utilize to collect signatures (e.g., Trump resistance protests and other similar activities, busy downtowns, and, conveniently, the Maine Democratic Party’s Feb. 28 and March 1 municipal caucuses). If you are interested in helping, please let us know by emailing us at mailto:campaign@costelloforsenate.com or David directly at costellodavida37@gmail.com. Thank you and best,Team Costello P.S. A few of David’s recent issue statements: Nuclear Arms Control What does Senator Susan Collins have to say? Today marks the expiration of the last NUCLEAR ARMS CONTROL treaty between the US and Russia. Leaving both nations with no limits on the size or structure of their arsenals for the first time since 1972; at the very moment both are planning new generations of nuclear weapons and delivery systems. And frighteningly, at a time when our anti-immigration and self-dealing and promotion crazed presidential administration is focused elsewhere. Along with addressing America’s unsolved affordability challenges – (which could be addressed by enacting Medicare for all and universal childcare, and investing more in retirement security, education, and housing, and funding these efforts via increased taxes on the wealthy) – we need the Trump Administration to prioritize nuclear disarmament negotiations and agreements. Adding more, particularly non-recallable missiles, to ours’s and our potential adversaries’ (Russia, China and North Korea) nuclear arsenals, as is currently underway, is not the sanest way forward. We should instead, along with our allies (UK and France) and other nuclear powers (India, Pakistan and Isreal), be working to advance global disarmament treaties that center on replacing the concept of mutually assured destruction (MAD) with that of minimally assured deterrence (i.e., the idea of nuclear armed nations’ having just enough nuclear weapons to deter advisories, but nowhere near enough collectively to wipe out humanity)... And while they’re at, the world’s nuclear powers should also consider doing a lot more to mitigate humanities' other potential existential threats: climate change and unconstrained artificial intelligence (AI)... Money’s Corrupting Influence on Politics and Government What does Senator Collins have to say? MONEY has forever had a corrupting influence on American politics and government, and its deleterious impact has never been more evident than is the case today. It poisons our democracy in that it obliterates political equality, a fundamental tenant of democracy, by drowning out ordinary voices and skewing government actions in favor of wealthy individuals and corporations and eroding the public’s trust in government. One only needs to see evidence of the recent flood of super PAC spending and “dark money” to understand the harmful extent to which money, and money funded mis- and dis-information, has over our politics and government. To remedy this situation, we should ratify the “For Our Freedom Amendment,” which would allow Congress and the states to lessen the influence of excessive “dark” and other campaign funding; establish a public financing program for US House and Senate campaigns; and create an independent, nonpartisan Federal Elections and Ethics Commission with strong oversight and enforcement authority to oversee elections, governmental ethics, and campaign financing. Additionally, aside from tackling the corrupting influence of money, we should also consider other elections related reforms, like: modernizing our nation’s voting infrastructure; mandating automatic voter registration, early voting, and no-excuse voting by mail; banning unreasonable voter purges, deceptive politicking, and partisan gerrymandering; expanding civics education mandates and programs; funding journalistically ethical, non-profit news organizations; and enacting social media regulations that oblige social media platforms to adhere to strict privacy, anti-violence incitement, and fact-based public interest information rules. It’s well past time that we did more, a lot more to fix our imperfect democracy and government... Senator Collins Needs to Stand Up to Trump or Step Aside Democracy requires that we stand up and speak out... That said, Senator Susan Collins needs to employ what diminishing leverage she has over the federal government’s budget process to end the secret police-state style tactics being utilized by the Trump Administration in Maine, MN, and elsewhere to scare, demonize, and round-up immigrants and to harm lawful protestors. Having failed earlier to thwart enactment of the President’s Big Ugly Bill, which cut healthcare and child nutrition programs to fund tax cuts for America’s wealthiest; block the nominations of highly unqualified department heads (e.g., Pete Hegseth, Kristi Noem, Robert Kennedy, Lee Zeldin, and Linda McMahon); and mitigate such harmful foreign policy actions as favoring Russia over Ukraine, dismantling USAID and eviscerating the State Department, and undermining critical economic and environmental agreements and security alliances – – Senator Collins needs to either step up and stand up to the Trump Administration or step aside... Expressions of concern aren’t sufficient... | | | | | | | | | | | Costello for Senate P.O. Box 1038 Brunswick, ME 04011-3449 * USA or |

Brandon Herrera

Peter -

Last year, after Donald Trump unleashed federal agents to terrorize immigrant communities across the country - hiding their identities and operating with zero accountability - we took action.

We passed first in the nation legislation requiring ICE agents to unmask and clearly identify themselves when operating in our state. **And this week, we got good news.**

A court ruled that California _**does**_ have the power to ban federal agents from concealing their identities.

**That ruling is a big deal - but there’s a catch.**

The court temporarily paused our law because it applies to local and federal law enforcement, _but not state police_. For the law to be enforced, it must apply to all levels of policing.

So I acted immediately, introducing new legislation to close that gap.

**[_Now I need your help, Peter. name: AOC
subject: "Isn't impeachment a waste of time?"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
The other day someone on Instagram asked me: “Isn’t impeachment a waste of time? Are other investigations more efficient?”
**This is a very good question** because there are a lot of different factors when it comes to impeachment. These include: when is the right time to impeach; the actual terrain that you're working with; and the substance of impeachment.
A lot of people think impeachment is just a piece of paper that says, “Do you impeach this person?” / “Do you think this person is good or bad?”
Impeachment is like an adapted form of a trial or criminal trial.
There need to be charges, and you have to identify the high crimes, misdemeanors, or other bases through which you would seek impeachment of an individual person. Then you have to try your case.
**But it requires a lot of build up to happen. It doesn’t just happen at the drop of a dime.**
It’s a discussion and pressure that builds into a moment of culmination when articles are finally presented on the House floor.
On terrain, you have to look at the votes that you’re working with, what parties are in the majority.
You have to consider the merit of, “Is it worth putting impeachment articles on the floor even if you know you’re going to lose the vote?”
You don’t just impeach people that you don’t like, but “has the person committed a high crime and misdemeanor?"
**With Kristi Noem, I absolutely think she has risen to the level of impeachment.**
The outrage over her misconduct is so bipartisan that I believe pursuing impeachment on Kristi Noem if the president doesn’t remove her is warranted, substantive, and justified.
We do not have to comply with illegal activity — even if that illegal activity is coming from the President of the United States or his administration.

body:

#
# **Bell-to-Bell Cell Phone Legislation Has Passed the Senate**
_Bell-to-Bell legislation will help both students and teachers get the most out of the school day_ Bipartisan Bell-to-Bell legislation that has been led by Senator Hughes and his colleagues, Senators Santarsiero and Robinson, [passed the Pennsylvania Senate](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171385.172229.14&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16554). That means Pennsylvania is one step closer to getting digital distractions out of our classrooms. **Good news for students and teachers** The goal is to boost academic focus and support students' mental health. The Bell-to-Bell bill would establish a statewide standard for phone-free schools. This means students will be free of the incessant desire to constantly check their phones. And teachers won't have to police the use of cell phones in their classrooms and fight for attention during important learning time. Each individual school district will be responsible for crafting a policy that works best for their community. **Research shows teenagers aged 13-18 spend an average of 90 minutes on their smartphones during school hours, amounting to roughly 25% of the school day.**
* * *
Senator Hughes [stopped by Good Day Philadelphia to discuss the new cell phone legislation](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171385.172229.14&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16555) and how it will improve learning in our schools. Watch below. [](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171385.172229.14&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16555)
* * *
If enacted, Pennsylvania would join 28 states with student cellphone restrictions, including 19 states enforcing Bell-to-Bell bans. Data has shown many benefits of a Bell-to-Bell policy, including:
* Increased focus and academic performance
* Reduction in cyberbullying
* Encouragement of social interaction- especially during lunch periods and in hallways between classes
* Improved mental health

* * *
**Next Steps** The bill now moves to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives. Once it passes in the House, Governor Shapiro said he will sign it into law. School districts would then be required to have their "Bell-to-Bell" policies in place no later than the start of the 2027-28 school year. That means Pennsylvania is one step closer to getting digital distractions out of our classrooms. Good news for students and teachers The goal is to boost academic focus and support students' mental health. The Bell-to-Bell bill would establish a statewide standard for phone-free schools. This means students will be free of the incessant desire to constantly check their phones. And teachers won't have to police the use of cell phones in their classrooms and fight for attention during important learning time. Each individual school district will be responsible for crafting a policy that works best for their community. Research shows teenagers aged 13-18 spend an average of 90 minutes on their smartphones during school hours, amounting to roughly 25% of the school day. Senator Hughes and how it will improve learning in our schools. Watch below. If enacted, Pennsylvania would join 28 states with student cellphone restrictions, including 19 states enforcing Bell-to-Bell bans. Last week, I spoke to the Association of Pittsburgh Priests about my course at Duquesne Law School, "Faith and Democracy." It was the first time I've talked this much about the 2022 campaign, and more broadly about my experience of faith during my five years in politics. You can watch it here:
[Faith and Democracy Talk on YouTube](https://substack.com/redirect/0ec46510-3b88-4024-a1ca-607e7f53b110?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I think I probably bit off more than I could chew with this presentation, in the sense that I was trying to fit in an account of my own experience plus describe the work of all the great thinkers we cover in my course. But it's a start. If you're part of any group, religious or otherwise, that might appreciate an improved version of this presentation, please reach out.

Peter,
Right now, 232 American athletes are competing on the world stage at the Winter Olympics in Milano Cortina. They trained for years for this moment — early mornings, late nights, sacrifice after sacrifice — all for a chance to win.
**Four of those athletes are Texans.**
We are impressed beyond measure by these incredible athletes.
And each of them understands something important:
You don’t beat entrenched competitors with half-measures. You win by showing up every day, putting in the work, and refusing to quit when the odds are long.
That’s exactly what this campaign is going to take.
Electing Gina as the next Governor of Texas will take hard work and dedication.
**[If you’re with us, chip in $5 or anything you can give right now.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260211_1_olympics.TLs_Uj&refcode=em20260211-561&amount=5&t=1&akid=561%2E299639%2EcYQrLN)**
Let’s be honest: Greg Abbott isn’t going to be easy to beat.
He’s had decades to entrench himself in power, millions of dollars from billionaires and corporate donors, and a political machine built to protect itself at all costs.
Gina has spent her entire career training for moments like this — standing up to corruption, fighting for public schools, taking on powerful interests, and winning when everyone said it couldn’t be done. She’s beaten Abbott again and again, on issue after issue, because she knows how to outwork and outfight him.
But just like Olympic athletes don’t compete alone — they have coaches, teammates, family, friends — Gina can’t do this without real support behind her.
Winning statewide means building the strongest grassroots operation Texas has ever seen. That means organizing everywhere, communicating relentlessly, and staying in this fight for the long haul. It means matching dedication with dedication, discipline with discipline.
And that’s where you come in, Peter:
**[If you believe Texas deserves a governor who works as hard for our kids and communities as Olympic athletes work for their country, please chip in $5 today to help power this campaign forward.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260211_1_olympics.TLs_Uj&refcode=em20260211-561&amount=5&t=2&akid=561%2E299639%2EcYQrLN)**

Every dollar helps fuel the training, the organizing, and the momentum we’ll need to win — not just against Abbott, but against the entire system propping him up.
Texans know how to do hard things. And when we commit fully, we win.
Thank you,
Team Gina

---|---|---
On any Saturday morning across Mississippi, you can find them: home bakers selling pecan pies from their kitchens, church members raising funds with pound cakes, families making jams and jellies from backyard fruit. These "cottage food" producers embody Mississippi's work ethic and entrepreneurial spirit. Yet under current law, the state tells them, "You can only succeed so much."
House Bill 910 would finally change that.
In plain terms, HB910 does two simple but powerful things. First, it removes the annual gross sales cap on cottage food operations -- the arbitrary limit on how much these home-based businesses are allowed to earn each year. Second, it allows them to sell online, by mail, wholesale, and through third-party retailers directly to consumers in Mississippi.
That's it. No new bureaucracy, no new program, no new tax. Just more freedom for Mississippians to work, create, and trade.
Right now, a home baker who starts to find real success hits a government-imposed ceiling. Imagine a single parent in Tupelo who builds a loyal following for her gluten-free breads. Under current law, once she reaches the cap, she must either turn customers away or shut down growth unless she's ready to take on expensive commercial kitchen costs. A law that was supposed to help small businesses ends up punishing the very people it was meant to support.
Removing the cap doesn't guarantee success, but it stops the government from limiting it.
Allowing online and expanded sales channels is just as important. In 2026, telling entrepreneurs they can't sell their products online is like telling farmers they can't use tractors. A retired veteran in Natchez who makes the best spice rub in the county should be free to sell it through a website or a local grocery store without having to navigate outdated restrictions. Consumers who want to support local producers shouldn't have to track them down at a farmer's market when a click or a simple in-store purchase would do.
HB910 is a modest, commonsense reform -- but it touches fundamental liberty principles.
It respects property rights: if you own your kitchen, your time, and your recipe, you should be free to use them to earn a living, so long as you're honest with your customers. It strengthens voluntary exchange: willing buyers and willing sellers should be allowed to do business without the state artificially standing in the way. And it advances limited government: state agencies shouldn't be in the business of deciding how much a home baker is "allowed" to prosper.
Safety concerns are often raised in these debates, but Mississippi already limits cottage foods to non-potentially hazardous products and requires clear labeling. HB910 doesn't erase common-sense protections; it removes economic shackles that have nothing to do with health and everything to do with control.
Legislators often talk about supporting small business, rural opportunity, and self-reliance. HB910 is a chance to prove it. More home-based businesses mean more income in local communities, more options for consumers, and more Mississippians charting their own course rather than waiting on government help.
Mississippians should contact their representatives and senators and urge them to pass HB910. It's time to get out of the kitchen of home entrepreneurs and let them cook -- and sell -- as much as the free market will bear.

**_Donald Trump is planning on attacking payment processor ActBlue in another attempt by his administration to push the limits of his power._**
The detainment of Mahmoud Kahlil, the deportation of Kilmar Abrego Garcia, and the outright denial to follow a ruling made by the Supreme Court are all blatant oversteps that attack our right to free speech and due process and challenge the rule of law.
Friend, I've spent years watching Fox News and listening to their rhetoric get more and more extreme, and Donald Trump is doing exactly what they want.
**_Fascism is, and has always been, their end goal._**
Their vision is one of a militarized country where only certain people—a few dozen rich men—have a seat at the table, and dissidents like me are silenced.
Trump and Elon know that progressive movements like ours are in the way because I've made it abundantly clear that strongly worded letters, wearing matching outfits while holding up signs, and meaningless acts of symbolism **aren't my thing.**
As a member of Congress, I'm going to be unwavering in my fight for our communities.
I will not vote for authoritarian bills in the name of "compromise," I will not abandon or demonize vulnerable groups to cater to the right, and I will not change my stances for fear of retaliation.
And Friend, that's what this action on ActBlue is: retaliation. Campaigns like ours rely on small dollars from people like you to support us, and ActBlue is integral to making that work.
[**If you can before you go, can you chip in (through ActBlue) to help us continue to fund mutual aid efforts and bring our unwavering commitment to the people of our district to Congress?**](https://ka4il.us/l/qnBWPeuXJ0Bw)
