Netanyahu Meets Trump on Iran

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrives at the White House today for high-stakes talks with President Trump centered on Iran's nuclear program. Netanyahu, who [met last night](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O4yAUhZ_G7rCA4L-CYpt02XZL6wauDQoGC66XZJ5-5HmEKU5zjnT06fv3WB7gg4_bX9hRZ1oXm-yy--AJ8qe4lKjYVOOOb28gLpLLgXHJhFiOnMqBhhbRWm2NBWFa1GIc-aTGaeat02a0XKy8R4FcWpwnfMKkbrIfRD_AOLdeX4dcCiGvzN0KvQEJRill1KDWRnEImKnLeJzPcDEQlNeassHOpL0N2hEdpbn9aeS9kfdaa7emd8Rarv1qUg62kXfK536wiATxA-5kOyKx6jwhc-ksyJzfHCsELyyMILwK8xki2-AL2BEgtlnbo_oQfBnGRvFtBx9-IOjX5v5r-R0AAP__MkuEGw) with Trump envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, wants any U.S.-Iran deal to include limits on Tehran's ballistic missiles -- not just nuclear restrictions. Trump [told Fox Business](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O5CAMgJ-GdIyAIyFbUFyTbq-9MvKAk6DlJwLn2Hn7U-YRtnDlT58_-e_n-gkhhrz_gYS20rb64tcUYiCor3aUQs2XnhN-Bwd5VUJNXCgu5XrW0k50tMrBW-88SDeglcaIWZv5QwyHnc2kDWhj5KxnL9Ro5nF22j9BjbCNfgj2Fgolpbrn47HB6ECB01o7PemNaQERKz0qntcz3g0E7Wsr1eHDlTREexCdjf36zdTC1NJ7f3RoR8g7lUwhYbs5ppaMvTG13AeZWjZ8MrVI-V4Q5BccF7_qjhy_T8gePQ8VMieIX433gydECnnnVK908gavxgmPG-mQ6TYP1fqzhxhDmwzTYk8Q4juSfvzZf1b9DwAA__-r5Y1T) that Iran wants to make a deal, warning: "We took out their nuclear power last time, and we'll have to see if we take out more this time." The meeting is their seventh since Trump's second term began, with [Iran and Gaza](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD2OnzAQR09jOiNs_MdQuEhDt2lTook94FH8gWyz7Ob0ESvlAltM9-anp_frbXsDCpSOnxDRlLZvLrstUqAG5bP6nFt1-U4RP8hC2uQgJz5ILsR2llxPtG0TnTPOOhC2QyO0Hmal52XovNG4AKgFAHbQwqKGabavcdm1GPWMS0fmGRykEPK5pd_hZUGCVUpZNamdqQECltYXPK_f4XFoUP_suVjsbY5dML61s7LxB5Mrk-t93_0N1VM6Wk74AZESlgdlck1414fx1JD7fFVkclXqNY7TzORKBRI_4C9wSI5jcpQO_r8FB3K8ZU61AAbuIR08v2PhrVzx_PpI2CB9gr94RGyUDibXrhh33hQC1UkzNRwRKHyZt2_nfjfyXwAAAP__WmaWWw) topping the agenda. ★★★
Cartel Drones Breach U.S. Airspace

Mexican cartel drones breached American airspace [near El Paso](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL1u7CAQhZ8Gd6wwl2ubgiKNu02b0podwEY7Bgtmf_L2kfMIKU51pHM-fV_X5QqJUl4_YQ-uclx88cueKDHU77aVws2XV97DOyHkRSs9SKVl3y9HLe0IyEvfeefRQ49dcP04qsmMk1Xd5jxYHxRMdsAwDSZYO_loEG_RIgLaLrlzUOm-12fsJcJ_BA1ojEEzmCiMAgqVLzUcjxudDAztHkvFcMGyd-Q25qOJfx9Cz0LP91je_DwroeccXk3omQoCCT1HALnW8si-SSCSkdK6cZNcJGQvYy27DCQPaEU-MieSMdykVl11_nglotSGURi17pDo953_rOzp9E8AAAD__y84gR4), triggering a stunning overnight shutdown of the city's international airport. The FAA [grounded all flights](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGSozAQRL8GMlGSLAsTKLiEzJdeSA3SYKZOSJRGXszfb7GfsEFnXV2v37_n9ASKlF5_YUNX6jKFHKaNIlUoJ685Vw75SBt-yEOatNRWSC2UmvaSeUdfJ9UGF3wA5Vt0qu_lw_SPQbarCzMOoGdv70EGG3QYZo2PO5oBjL1Z25K7BqVWSl8ZugXuHjR4Y4w31iyNkRCx1K7g_p7jxVCB_y-5eOx83tro1lp3bm5_Gj02ejyOo1vyZ34zJWS-Oo0e0eeUt7PR4wIgVoiVBcQolkivtbLAKHbgLChVLAkq5QRRAJU9lyqUFAFOFtddgigY_btQPUVB4Jy4LS7sB8VIbPvGyNcGFH_o6q-Vfjn9HQAA__9oco4o) -- commercial, cargo, and general aviation -- for what was supposed to be 10 days, warning that violators could face "deadly force." The Department of War shot down the drones, and the FAA lifted restrictions on Wednesday morning. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed the FAA and military "acted swiftly to address a cartel drone incursion." Local officials slammed [Washington's failure to communicate](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGSpCAQhp8Gs7agZdQNCC4x20svtFpoRupQKMCb3be_ch5hg06__v7vz-f6SSGG8_mbDjal-dUltx4hhkblu-4pterS6zz4K1g6V5Q4gkRQas0l1cy2rapzxllHynZs1DTJWU_zh-x2M7BSg2SPo97U6IdNs51nTX7j6WHlowvmBkpUCu_76D09LCFZrbXVo_ZCS4pcWl84X1u8HRrVvz4Vy71NRxfN3lquYvglcBG4cMxU00Gtcal9Kk-By_1D4CJR4KKUwOU6-StHCic78ESQiuMCdb9ahXstcIQbAzVdbedywskveDdIQKHUTJbBpwJKgqPvKnDpinH5FWIMdZyEls-DQnwrth93_WfwfwAAAP__uoaMLA) before the unprecedented lockdown. ★★★
Grand Jury Rejects "Seditious Six"

A federal grand jury refused to indict six Democratic lawmakers who urged military members to "refuse illegal orders" in a video that [enraged President Trump](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGunDAQRb8GOiPs54eXwkUauk2bEg2eMXjXYDT2xrt_HxEpP5DiVlc6Ojq_7vMdQgzH-hN2slz8jAnnPcRQgD95S6lkTPXY6R0cHLPq1SB6JaScT075JFdm2aJFhyBdS1Ya09-0uY19u1mPRkk_msV_O6RBef81elykN2bAZVnaYC9gr6RU18bOw7cDBU5r7fSgfaN7iMSlYzpfS7wcCuSnT-yoc2lvo91KOXPz9aNRU6OmWmvn0_ugmq-_UdOZYijB5UZNK8OB4vHij2B6kCtZYHoI8j5xEeHA4IpA2pNjKMGJCHWHJ3EWdUvixSuh-NdGIPmPCDHSClEkRuLcssWzhhhDHkyj-3WHEP9qlv9u-9uqPwEAAP__s2GS0w). The DOJ investigation targeted Sens. Mark Kelly and Elissa Slotkin and four House Democrats -- all military or intelligence veterans. Trump had called their November video "seditious behavior, [punishable by death](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2S3SAMhZ8Gd9wBlmvfLSjSuNu0KT0yyLYSfjwgx7tvnyGPsIUKzWg-fef8-lg-gCLl_SckdJW3JZSwJIrEUL_aUQq3UO6c8JM85MUoM0plpNbLWUs70fOih-CCD6D9gE5Pk3rZ6fWuhsMpb5_TtAbQa1AKRnyhNa_w9lRPi6NdB3IdqIzWps_7Y4OnBwPeWuvtaDdhFUSs_Kh4XmvsDgztz1aqx4cvaYjuYD6bePshzCzMfN_344Z2UN65ZKaErd8JM2e8mzBzfyjMvOEqzKyVMHMPgv7iUpvcgKLsW0W5V8hB_r7ql6QcyHPCzLJhIKZyNdnoUwZMxVfgTh6qC-dNMVIbJ2HVnoDif0n-drN_nfkXAAD__4G-jkg)." The declination marks the latest grand jury rebuke of the administration's attempts to prosecute political opponents. House Speaker Mike Johnson responded that the lawmakers ["probably should be indicted"](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2S3SAMhZ8Gd9wBlmvfLSjSuNu0KT0yyLYSfjwgx7tvnyGPsIUKzWg-fef8-lg-gCLl_SckdJW3JZSwJIrEUL_aUQq3UO6c8JM85MUoM0plpNbLWUs70fOih-CCD6D9gE5Pk3rZ6fWuhsMpb5_TtAbQa1AKRnyhNa_w9lRPi6NdB3IdqIzWps_7Y4OnBwPeWuvtaDdhFUSs_Kh4XmvsDgztz1aqx4cvaYjuYD6bePshzCzMfN_344Z2UN65ZKaErd8JM2e8mzBzfyjMvOEqzKyVMHMPgv7iUpvcgKLsW0W5V8hB_r7ql6QcyHPCzLJhIKZyNdnoUwZMxVfgTh6qC-dNMVIbJ2HVnoDif0n-drN_nfkXAAD__4G-jkg) regardless.

House Advances SAVE America Act

The House Rules Committee advanced the [SAVE America Act](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLHOozAQhJ8GOiPbvwOhcHENXa69Ei3rdVjFYGQ7cfL2J_IIfzHVjEbfzL_bfAMOvN__wkY2FT-76OaNAxdIn7zGWLKLdd_ozQj7rKXuhdRCqflIMR-EZVatsw4dKGzJqmGQVzNcR9mudlGjG0ENEns_9PoiPSh1HXCR_me5uLFlexZKrZQ-NXYeLgga0BiDpje-MRICpdIlOp5LOBkK5IePCanDuLXBrqUcufn50-ip0VOttfPxvVPNp9_o6YiBC2Nu9PSgj1jjM5PAuG1cCpEA94IdKYsdCse9siPxioWSYCcWDkHASuDEdzkFwjOV22TdUTkEzv3QGHnfgMMXqPz6xZfV_wMAAP__fVGIHg) on Tuesday, teeing up a floor vote on the bill requiring photo ID and proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections ahead of the 2026 midterms.

Congress has just days to avert a [DHS shutdown](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2y4yAMhZ8Gd2SwTOxQUGzjLttu6VGEHDPBxoPIZvft73Af4RZSc2a-8_Pnvtwxpng8f-POvtR1CTkse0yxYvkvW85VQv4cO_-LhMcCBkZtQPf9cpYsJ1Nd-i74QAF76tj302Rudro5023ehBGA3Hq7Dm4YHA3WIYXAbuLRTJProm9AA30P7dxlxSshIFlryY52VdZg4lIvhc_3I7UMFeW15kJ8obx3yW-1nqKGXwpmBXPJKRGm1EQFc8MrmA205xTMdYuiP8wvHTbRKxKLPrNIfCTWsr1ra6txYww6r5ry8SwsEvOBSRcmFlEwd8WH8xNTijJOyprnjvHbsqs_HvGvh68AAAD__9HghOU) as Democrats demand ICE reforms and Republicans call those demands "non-starters." The department's two-week funding patch expires February 13.

America isn’t about loyalty to one man, it’s about loyalty to the Constitution. Defending that is something I will never shy away from.
**_BREAKING: Grand Jury Rebuffs Justice Dept. Attempt to Indict 6 Democrats in Congress_**
Peter, this is outrageous.
Trump’s Justice Department prosecutors just tried (and failed) to indict me and five of my colleagues for stating the law in a way they didn’t like. No one can force our troops to follow illegal orders, and the oath to the Constitution is sacred.
**In response? A group of regular Americans sitting on a grand jury looked at this and said:_No. This is not a crime._**
That’s because Americans know and believe that our Constitution is not a polite suggestion to those in power—we take an oath to support and defend the Constitution, and that is bigger than any weak man or his even weaker enablers.
This was an abuse of power, and Americans shut it down.
**[Donald Trump and his Justice Department have tried to indict us—trying to intimidate and harass me and my colleagues. This failed attempt shows that our truth and commitment to the Constitution outweighs his threats. Back in November, several of my colleagues and I released a video reaffirming a basic constitutional truth: the oath to the Constitution comes above all. No service member is required to follow an illegal order. Full stop.
Trump’s response? He tried to bully and intimidate us into silence.
He went so far as to have his allies at the Justice Department push for criminal charges against members of Congress for saying things he didn’t like.
**Donald Trump and his administration tried to intimidate us. Indict us.**
_But a group of everyday Americans sitting on that grand jury looked at this case and shut it down._
That almost never happens. Prosecutors almost always get the indictments they ask for. The fact that American citizens rejected this tells you everything—they could see what this really was: an abuse of power meant to punish people for standing up for the Constitution.
**Peter, even in this moment of intimidation and chaos, ordinary Americans still recognize the difference between the rule of law and raw political revenge.**
I first swore an oath to the Constitution as a 17-year-old at the Naval Academy. I took that oath again when I was elected to represent Western Pennsylvania in Congress.
That oath is sacred. It’s lifelong. It doesn’t expire. And it doesn’t bend to threats or tantrums from a would-be strongman.
America isn’t about loyalty to one man, it’s about loyalty to the Constitution. Defending that is something I will never shy away from.

_" Whatever you do, make sure this country is there for the next families who need it."_
That's a lesson my parents instilled in me as a young boy. It shaped how I see the world, how I approach public service, and why I'm running for the United States Senate.
**[Before I go on, I hope I can count on your support today. My election is just weeks away, so anything you can do will make a big difference.->](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0b352383-31ea-4019-a3b9-9f6ca4c10f7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE NOW ->](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0b352383-31ea-4019-a3b9-9f6ca4c10f7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### **My Family 's Story**
My parents immigrated from India to this country when I was a baby. Like so many immigrant families, they were searching for the American Dream - a chance to build a better life for our family.
They sacrificed everything for that dream. My dad worked multiple jobs. My mom stretched every dollar. They believed that America was a place where, if you played by the rules and contributed to your community, you could make it.
But when my father lost his income in the early 1970s, we fell on hard times. We lived in public housing. We depended on food stamps to put food on the table. The safety net that people love to criticize in political debates became the thing that kept my family afloat.
That's how I stand before you today as a member of Congress and a candidate for the United States Senate - a living embodiment of the American Dream.
### **The Country My Parents Believed In Is Slipping Away**
But here's what keeps me up at night: the country my parents believed in is slipping away.
Donald Trump is cruelly tearing apart immigrant families like mine. He's unleashed ICE to operate with impunity and is spreading terror throughout communities across the country.
He let ACA tax credits expire, causing premiums to skyrocket. He's targeting food assistance programs. He's attacking the very safety net that made my story possible.
Life is getting harder for working families - and he's making it worse. Tax cuts for billionaires while families struggle with rising costs. Unconstitutional wars for oil company profits while Americans can't afford health care.
This isn't the America my parents believed in.
### **This Is Personal to Me**
I'm running for Senate because this is deeply, fundamentally personal to me.
When I see Trump tearing apart immigrant families, I see my own family. When I see him attacking programs that help families during hard times, I remember living in public housing. When I see him abandoning the promise of America, I think about my parents' belief that this country would be there for people like us.
I'll fight with everything I have to make sure this country is still there for the next families who need it. That's why I'm running - to honor the lesson my parents taught me.
### **This Election Is Our First Chance to Fight Back**
My election is less than two months away, and early voting has already begun. This will be one of the FIRST opportunities of 2026 to prove to Trump that we won't let him get away with this kind of cruelty.
Donald Trump doesn't want people like me anywhere near the U.S. Senate. He doesn't want senators who remember what it's like to struggle, who understand why safety net programs matter, who will fight to protect immigrant families.
But Trump doesn't get to decide who represents Illinois. You do. We do. Together.
### **I Need Your Help**
I'm building this campaign with grassroots support from people who believe America should be a place where families get a fair shot, where hard work is rewarded, where we lift each other up.
We're up against wealthy, shady Super PACs spending seven figures to defeat us.
We're reaching voters while early voting is underway. We need to prove that grassroots campaigns can win.
If you believe this country should still be there for the next families who need it, I need your support to get to the Senate and fight for them.
Every dollar helps us reach voters during early voting, counter Super PAC spending, and send Trump a message that his cruelty will not go unanswered.
My parents didn't sacrifice everything just so their son could watch America abandon the values that made our story possible. They would want me to fight - to stand up for immigrant families, to defend safety net programs, to make sure the American Dream is real for the next generation.

Feb 11 | | | | | | | | | | | " Whatever you do, make sure this country is there for the next families who need it." That's a lesson my parents instilled in me as a young boy. It shaped how I see the world, how I approach public service, and why I'm running for the United States Senate. My Family 's Story My parents immigrated from India to this country when I was a baby. Like so many immigrant families, they were searching for the American Dream - a chance to build a better life for our family. They sacrificed everything for that dream. My dad worked multiple jobs. My mom stretched every dollar. They believed that America was a place where, if you played by the rules and contributed to your community, you could make it. But when my father lost his income in the early 1970s, we fell on hard times. We lived in public housing. We depended on food stamps to put food on the table. The safety net that people love to criticize in political debates became the thing that kept my family afloat. That's how I stand before you today as a member of Congress and a candidate for the United States Senate - a living embodiment of the American Dream. The Country My Parents Believed In Is Slipping Away But here's what keeps me up at night: the country my parents believed in is slipping away. Donald Trump is cruelly tearing apart immigrant families like mine. He's unleashed ICE to operate with impunity and is spreading terror throughout communities across the country. He let ACA tax credits expire, causing premiums to skyrocket. He's targeting food assistance programs. He's attacking the very safety net that made my story possible. Life is getting harder for working families - and he's making it worse. Tax cuts for billionaires while families struggle with rising costs. Unconstitutional wars for oil company profits while Americans can't afford health care. This isn't the America my parents believed in. This Is Personal to Me I'm running for Senate because this is deeply, fundamentally personal to me. When I see Trump tearing apart immigrant families, I see my own family. When I see him attacking programs that help families during hard times, I remember living in public housing. When I see him abandoning the promise of America, I think about my parents' belief that this country would be there for people like us. I'll fight with everything I have to make sure this country is still there for the next families who need it. That's why I'm running - to honor the lesson my parents taught me. This Election Is Our First Chance to Fight Back My election is less than two months away, and early voting has already begun. This will be one of the FIRST opportunities of 2026 to prove to Trump that we won't let him get away with this kind of cruelty. Donald Trump doesn't want people like me anywhere near the U.S. Senate. He doesn't want senators who remember what it's like to struggle, who understand why safety net programs matter, who will fight to protect immigrant families. But Trump doesn't get to decide who represents Illinois. You do. We do. Together. I Need Your Help I'm building this campaign with grassroots support from people who believe America should be a place where families get a fair shot, where hard work is rewarded, where we lift each other up. We're up against wealthy, shady Super PACs spending seven figures to defeat us. We're reaching voters while early voting is underway. We need to prove that grassroots campaigns can win. If you believe this country should still be there for the next families who need it, I need your support to get to the Senate and fight for them. Every dollar helps us reach voters during early voting, counter Super PAC spending, and send Trump a message that his cruelty will not go unanswered. My parents didn't sacrifice everything just so their son could watch America abandon the values that made our story possible. They would want me to fight - to stand up for immigrant families, to defend safety net programs, to make sure the American Dream is real for the next generation. Thank you, Raja | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Raja Krishnamoorthi PO Box 681202, Schaumburg, IL 60168, United States ? ?

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Alongside Senators Chris Van Hollen and Angela Alsobrooks, I formally pressed Washington County officials over ICE’s secretive plan to convert a warehouse near Hagerstown into a massive immigration detention facility capable of holding up to _**1,500 people.**_

This proposal has moved forward without transparency, without community input, and without answers to basic questions about public safety, infrastructure, health care access, or human rights. **That is unacceptable.**

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Peter, I didn’t expect to be a Taylor Swift fan. That changed the night my daughter asked me to go with her to her first concert in 2018. Of course, I said yes, not because I knew every song, but because she asked. Somewhere along the way, it clicked. Not just the music, but what it meant to her, and what it meant to share something new together. That idea, being willing to say yes and stay open, matters far beyond music. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/yfgJXL_5E7TgsMW012rOCA~~/AAUS1hA~/hkaY9vooXwI6lt0CJOEfpKwIjvJJ9b8C_BbWTmc9FPfbSk-9ZMGzZp1Mqr4BN9nbFSv2Idc3T7vvMDdda9LZDeouer_AjXDfJBE69ekXSivN2Ckl39IshF8sK8bu0bJcYEYouCY9hb-WYEcFlo9TCcCYkOKooxEJjs9HBoHimbqHlw7bE2UOiZiheEeba1z_QjUmnwXr10J_2LLAApksG1Vca-FAOt1-7iPmEMuSj53e_1Y87Xd4gLUlfu4ZB2NU) As mayor, I’ve learned that the best leadership doesn’t come from pretending you already have all the answers. It comes from listening. From hearing people you agree with and people you don’t. Being willing to learn, adjust, and do better. Being open does not mean standing up for nothing. It means taking people seriously, no matter how small their request. It’s how trust is built, and it’s how real progress happens. That’s how I lead, and it’s how we’re running this campaign — grounded, open, and focused on bringing people together instead of shutting them out. **[If that kind of leadership is something you want to see more of, I hope you’ll chip in today to help keep this campaign moving forward.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/2x_yBIU5rUWqtoCfXQImGQ~~/AAUS1hA~/3TNaKoBGj9L2nRo5FEIqsMdG-c6AddHgS0Kb9dhKPze77jdgGp3sqMqG7vP7wfDOUXGa4XGoqftA_JbcbkEoSBQ1FGm7K1oi-tCZHBHPJ8BvuK3Wx3cfNFTpeXglsckVP2FrwqMrvAgMNJ9vxxUWVGhF4u-_GfHvI0q6droH5WSInUnUJYtpAwlVv_-ZjPvEV3N1RI-RNPycXRa0Wjqz7VPJkCgn1e7HlVcPuQG2Np3aubJ3_YYV64Jc4LCc7eeV)** | | [Chip in to support the campaign](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/dx7OBfdyZdvyyVHFoQyePg~~/AAUS1hA~/Gi7VS4bWdjG-1_sr20RmZ2M9mMtrAmfGI_nx1Ki0QpAedqhu84DfU_BXamAPNR_ScgbsJRidOErMSsi-zO3kRuI5hpnkyIRk0LypSUEZJaQTFhc0BdU_-zbpI-tP7XPx-yrqj83z5yuJCpNuiW89qn3SpP2v-j364V7BDI_ZaRsy6z5i1vn7Ixnt9in2XPb8mC1OQwKsjc60eeR1QlDS1kr_ykYC1h38Tp71TmRrcPDhPy-siifNCu-vBaPMxpF0)

body:
PA Dems have worked alongside me every step of the way

Derek, Last weekend, I was honored to earn the endorsement of the Pennsylvania Democratic Party. Over the past three years, we’ve gotten stuff done and delivered real results for Pennsylvanians all across the Commonwealth — growing our economy, investing in public safety, delivering historic funding for our kids’ education, and protecting our freedoms. **But there is still so much work left to do.** Here’s the good news: **I’m not in this fight alone.** PA Dems have worked alongside me every step of the way, building on all the progress we’ve made together. To have the faith of so many Democratic leaders — including Democrats from every one of Pennsylvania’s 67 counties — it’s an honor, Derek. As we work together this year to elect Democrats up and down the ballot, keep moving our Commonwealth forward, and continue to protect our freedoms and our democracy, I hope I can count on your support too. Because the outcome of this election will come down to one thing, and one thing only: **The support we’re able to earn from Pennsylvanians like you.** [_**So I’m humbly asking: Will you split a donation of any size between the Pennsylvania Democratic Party and my campaign to power our work here in Pennsylvania? body:
[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
Hi,

One of the things I value most about public service is the chance to
listen.

Over the past year, I’ve spent time in communities across Michigan,
talking with families, workers, small business owners, and students about
their lives and their hopes for the future. Those conversations have
stayed with me.

People care deeply about this state. They want a Michigan where hard work
is rewarded, where families can feel secure, and where their voices are
heard by the people making decisions.

That’s the Michigan I believe in, and it’s why your perspective matters to
me.

As we continue this campaign, I want to make sure we stay focused on what
matters most to people across our state. I want to hear what’s on your
mind, what challenges you’re facing, and what you think should be our
priorities moving forward.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/survey/2602-survey/?t=1001&akid=1524%2E181023%2Ev5t-ez ]If you’re willing, I hope you’ll take a moment to fill out this short
survey and share your thoughts. Hearing directly from you helps guide this
campaign and the work ahead.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/survey/2602-survey/?t=1002&akid=1524%2E181023%2Ev5t-ez ]Take The Survey →

Thank you for taking the time to be part of this conversation. I’m
grateful to be doing this work alongside you.

Jocelyn

# [One thing is clear](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=187683846&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg3NjgzODQ2LCJpYXQiOjE3NzA4NTA2OTIsImV4cCI6MTc3MzQ0MjY5MiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.BlbSNxKe7EeCRcN94a0FME9qciGswDeDd9PfX5f0hq0)
### I'm the only Democrat in this race who can take on Rogers and win
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Feb 11
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..6Q5omS2VrY0ZCCUfsKksv_XuxmsduhOCm70MQTKVGA8?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/one-thing-is-clear?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Hi friends,
**Earlier today, I wrapped up the UAW 's candidate forum in the race for Michigan's Senate seat,** and I want to share this moment with you.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6a74d4cc-f437-44ad-9713-d6874519f250?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Being able to stand on that stage and share my vision for Michigan's future was incredible. Since Day One of this campaign, I've been traveling and talking to thousands of folks across the state about what they want to see from their future leaders, and the message has been consistent.
Michiganders want their next senator to put in the real work and do what it takes to grow our economy, create good-paying jobs, and break down the systemic barriers that make it harder for Michiganders to get ahead.
That's exactly what I said I would do when I got on stage today, and the response was incredible.
**Between this forum and recent polls, it 's never been more clear: I'm the ONLY Democrat who can take on Rogers and win.**
But here's the other thing that's been on my mind since getting off stage: _**GOP operatives were watching this forum, too.**_
They've been listening and watching this race as closely as we have, and they're prepared to spend whatever it takes to win, because they want a rubber-stamp for Trump's chaos agenda. And if Republicans lose the Senate, they lose their chance to continue wreaking havoc in our communities, eroding our democracy, and evading accountability.
_You can see why GOP megadonors are throwing everything they 've got at this battleground race._
So the more clear it becomes that I'm the front-runner in this race, the harder MAGA Republicans are going to come at me.
It's absolutely critical that we're prepared for what's coming.
We can't afford to come up short, and with our mid-month deadline just around the corner, we're working with higher stakes - and a shorter month - than ever.
**Will you rush a gift before midnight to help us keep Michigan blue?**
[ Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/42edb6ad-7bd5-4eb9-9542-9aa710e8d928?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
With grit, gratitude, and a whole lot of hope,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/42edb6ad-7bd5-4eb9-9542-9aa710e8d928?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

name: Clarence Blalock
subject: Why I'm Running for Labor Commissioner
body:
| | | | | [|
---](https://clarenceforga.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=efd96dd0c8a43e432536538a3&id=33fea4e361&e=2c52619dc8)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Hello Friend,
My name is Clarence Blalock, and I’m running for Georgia Labor Commissioner.
I’m a native Georgian and I have witnessed our state transform from a republican stronghold to a battleground state where getting Democrats elected statewide is possible. I understand the incredible progress we are making, as well as the price we’ve paid for decades of misguided leadership. As a Northwest Georgia resident, I understand life inside and outside of the perimeter, and what we need to win this seat.
I know that the Georgia Department of Labor needs to operate quickly and efficiently, and deserves more funding in order to properly serve Georgians who need help. We can fix an underfunded department that struggles to help workers receive unemployment benefits or receive workforce training.
**Brian Kemp often says this is a great state to do business, but under a generation of Republican control, it has become a horrible state to be a worker.**
I’ve worked for the Coordinated Campaign to elect Kamala Harris and as Peter Hubbard’s campaign manager, who recently won his race for Public Service Commissioner with 63% of the vote.
**This was the first non-federal statewide win in 19 years**.
This is an opportunity for me to serve the state of Georgia in an often overlooked role that is essential to the livelihoods of the people who live here, but we must first nominate someone who knows how to win.
If you could help my campaign by donating 100, 50, or even 25 dollars, it would help send me over the finish line and give us the opportunity to take part in building a better Georgia.
Please donate at the following link if you can: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb2026](https://clarenceforga.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=efd96dd0c8a43e432536538a3&id=2bd1d1df8d&e=2c52619dc8)
Thank you for your support,

Clarence Blalock

At a time when US farm bankruptcies increased by 46% last year, Valadao chose to continue tariff policies that experts say could cost American households up to **$2,300 more per year** \-- driving up food prices and hurting and squeezing working families. This isn’t abstract.
And it isn’t accidental. Representing a region that produces **25% of the nation’s food** , Valadao sided with Washington politics over the Central Valley -- _again_. Instead of putting the Central Valley first, he’s choosing loyalty to Trump and loyalty to his corporate sponsors over the people he represents. name: Ilhan Omar
subject: Another corrupt sham
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2080%2E791427%2EAp346u)
Friend, for months now, Trump and the GOP have put a target on my back and spread baseless and defamatory conspiracies about me, my family, my immigration status, my financial situation, and my entire community here in Minneapolis.
These lies aren’t just rhetoric — they’ve led to Republicans trying to take me down with corrupt, sham investigations.
**First,** Trump wanted to find a legal way to act on their threats to revoke my citizenship and deport me.
**Then,** when that didn’t work, Trump’s lackeys at the DOJ opened an investigation into me, with Trump personally announcing the investigation in a post on social media.
**Now,** the GOP-led House Oversight Committee has opened their own investigation as a clear political stunt that has unfairly involved my family.
I want to be crystal clear: Baseless investigations into political opponents is a tactic of authoritarian regimes across the world and throughout history.
It’s an intimidation tactic. They want me to stop shining a light on Trump’s disastrous failures. To stop speaking out against the administration’s violent occupation of my district. To stop voting against any and all funding for ICE. **I will do nothing of the sort.**
If you’re with me as I stand strong in the face of these corrupt attacks, I’m asking you to join my campaign today by [**making your first contribution.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260211-1-f&t=2&akid=2080%2E791427%2EAp346u)
Your contribution helps me and my team tune out the noise and focus more resources on our fight to get ICE out of Minneapolis and organize our neighbors into a movement that can defeat the far-right. [**Chip in at this link or the button below.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260211-1-f&t=3&akid=2080%2E791427%2EAp346u)
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260211-1-f&t=4&akid=2080%2E791427%2EAp346u)**
Thank you, as always, for being part of this campaign and our movement for democracy, affordability, and justice for all.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

* The macro pressures influencing long-term demand
* What large capital is quietly preparing for — not promoting

* Value insight over commentary
* Prefer preparation over reaction
* Want clarity before decisions are forced on them

name: Roy Cooper
subject: My decision
body:
Together, we will win.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=544%2E124072%2E31ySYo)
Peter, deciding to run for this U.S. Senate seat wasn’t easy. I didn’t really want to go to Washington — I had always planned on serving North Carolina from here at home. That’s why I was so humbled when North Carolinians elected me to be governor. **But this race is too consequential. The stakes are too high. I couldn’t sit by.** When we started this campaign, I did so with a great sense of responsibility for all of you who are putting your trust in me — and even more hope. _Together, we will win._ Now, our campaign is up against our biggest financial challenge yet: We have an FEC pre-primary deadline at midnight tonight, after which we need to file a public report that our opponent and the GOP will see. **[I’m personally asking if you can be among the supporters who help meet our 10,000-donation goal by making your first $5 donation right now, before the deadline.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5431?amount=5&t=7&akid=544%2E124072%2E31ySYo)** | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5431?t=8&akid=544%2E124072%2E31ySYo)
---
Peter, I’m running because our nation cannot afford two more years of unchecked Republican power in Washington. The attacks on health care, on democratic values, and even on American citizens — they have to stop.
Instead, our leaders should be focusing on strengthening our communities by investing in public schools, securing health care access, and prioritizing hardworking folks over the wealthiest few. That’s what our administration did in North Carolina — creating jobs by expanding the clean energy economy, giving public school teachers a much-needed raise, expanding Medicaid, and more.
**This is the work I’m ready to do as the next Democratic Senator from North Carolina, when we flip this seat from red to blue and take back the Senate for the people. But there’s a lot of hard work ahead of us first.**
This is the most competitive race of my career. It’s one of only three Senate races rated toss-up. GOP mega-donors are ready and waiting to fall in line behind our official Republican opponent after the primary — and Peter, North Carolinians will begin early voting _tomorrow_ , so we’re running out of time to prove that momentum is on our side.
**[Chipping in $5, $25, or whatever amount is right for you before the deadline will help meet our goal and let everyone know that the people are with us. Please pitch in before midnight if you’re with us.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5431?t=9&akid=544%2E124072%2E31ySYo)**

Hi – it’s Jena.
Next month, Coloradans across the state will caucus, and I want to be very clear about why that matters so much for this campaign.
Caucus is where grassroots campaigns win. It’s where neighbors show up, organize, and decide what kind of leadership they want for Colorado’s future. If we want to win this race, we have to be ready. Caucus is how we’ll get on the ballot!
That starts with you signing up to caucus for our campaign.
When you sign up:
* You help us build strength in every corner of the state
* You make sure our supporters are organized and counted
* You help us show that protecting democracy, reproductive freedom, and the rule of law is a winning message in Colorado
Please take a moment today to sign up to caucus for our campaign today! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/rLuIVUXy80-xxMPfbrB89g2]
SIGN UP [https://secure.ngpvan.com/rLuIVUXy80-xxMPfbrB89g2]It’s one of the most important things you can do between now and next month, and it truly makes a difference.
Thank you for being part of this fight and for standing with me.
Jena
PS: if you have any questions about caucus, shoot Zach an email at zach@jenaforcolorado.com
Jena Griswold is running for Attorney General because Colorado needs a strong, proven leader in this critical moment. She'll stand up to Donald Trump to protect our rights and freedoms. She’ll fight for working- and middle-class Coloradans, hold big corporations accountable, and safeguard our land, air, and water.

name: Matthew Davis, LCV
subject: TAKE ACTION: Tell Congress to hold Trump’s EPA accountable!
body:
Trump and EPA administrator Zeldin are putting us all in danger

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM0NzQ1MzMS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQwMDczNDAxMAS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
| | | |
## _**Tell Congress:**_
**Hold Trump’s EPA Accountable!**
Trump and EPA administrator Zeldin just confirmed the repeal of the Endangerment Finding, one of the most important foundations for federal protections for our public health and the environment. This repeal is a blatant denial of climate science and of the harms experienced by survivors of climate disasters. It gives Trump's fossil fuel executive donors a free pass to pollute the air we breathe with greenhouse gases — meaning they’ll get richer while everyday people get sicker. [**_Tell Congress: Hold Trump and Zeldin accountable — we need an EPA that protects people, not corporate polluters!_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_)
---
| | | [ TAKE ACTION NOW >> ](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | Peter,
---
| | **Our lives are more important than corporate polluters’ profits.** But Trump and EPA administrator Zeldin just announced the repeal of the Endangerment Finding, one of the most important foundations for federal protections for the air we breathe, our public health, and the environment.
---
| | This repeal is a blatant denial of climate science and the lived experiences of tens of millions of our neighbors, friends, and families who have suffered fossil-fueled climate disasters like deadly floods, heat waves, hurricanes, droughts, and wildfires. At the same time, it gives Trump’s fossil fuel executive donors a free pass to pollute the air we breathe with toxic greenhouse gases — meaning these Big Oil and Gas donors will get richer while people and the planet pay the price.
---
| | **The EPA has one job: to protect our health and the environment.** Instead, Trump and Zeldin are gaslighting the public and denying the harms caused by the climate crisis and air pollution. We need an EPA that is working to SOLVE the climate crisis, not MAKE IT WORSE.
---
| | [**_Help us hold Trump and Zeldin accountable!_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzs~)
---
| | Here’s what the repeal means for the health and well-being of communities:
---
| |
* **Worsening public health.** More tailpipe exhaust from vehicles means more asthma attacks, strokes, heart disease, cancer, and premature deaths, especially for communities of color, low-income communities, and children and seniors.

---
| |
* **Higher costs for families.** Energy bills are already skyrocketing, and this repeal means less fuel-efficient vehicles, deepens our reliance on climate-destroying fossil fuels, and could cost everyday people hundreds of dollars a year at the pump, while enriching Trump’s Big Oil donors.

---
| |
* **More climate disasters.** More frequent and severe wildfires, droughts, floods, and crop failures, driving up costs and food insecurity while deadly heat and storms ravage our communities.** **

---
| | This is climate denial and corporate-backed corruption at its worst, Peter. Thank you for standing with us to hold these polluters accountable and to help protect each other, our planet, and future.
---
| | Matthew Davis
Vice President of Federal Policy
League of Conservation Voters

# **Canada 's worst school shooting in 30 years carried out by transgender teenager**
Jesse Van Rootselaar, **[a transgender teenager born male who identified as female](https://substack.com/redirect/65eee761-8cc2-4aee-bb5e-aec480f358c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and had been transitioning for six years, killed eight people in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia on Tuesday -- first shooting his mother and brother at home before traveling to Tumbler Ridge Secondary School where he killed four students and one teacher before dying of a self-inflicted gunshot wound.
## [Watch:](https://substack.com/redirect/65eee761-8cc2-4aee-bb5e-aec480f358c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/65eee761-8cc2-4aee-bb5e-aec480f358c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Why it matters:** The attack is Canada's deadliest school shooting in more than 30 years, leaving 27 others wounded including 12-year-old Maya Gebala, who is in critical condition after being shot in the head and neck. Critically, Van Rootselaar had previously had guns seized during mental health checks, but the weapons were returned after the gun owner filed a petition.
* **The response:** Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney suspended his trip to the Munich Security Conference and appeared visibly emotional on camera, saying "parents, grandparents, sisters, brothers, in Tumbler Ridge will wake up without someone they love." King Charles said he and the Queen were "profoundly shocked and saddened," while British Columbia Premier David Eby said the swift police response "prevented a devastating tragedy from being significantly worse."
* **The backdrop:** The shooting has reignited debate over transgender policies in Canada, as Tumbler Ridge sits near the border with Alberta, which recently passed laws banning trans youth from women's sports and requiring parents to be informed if children change pronouns at school. Van Rootselaar was not a student at the school at the time of the shooting, and police said the motive remains unknown, with Superintendent Ken Floyd acknowledging "we will struggle to determine the 'why.'"

# CNN hemorrhages two-thirds of viewers since 2016
CNN's **[primetime viewership has plummeted nearly two-thirds](https://substack.com/redirect/f9b03b0d-9150-4d8c-8571-723901f41e04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** since 2016, dropping from about 1.3 million to just 553,000 amid leadership turmoil, shifting news consumption habits, and failed adaptations, sparking fears the network is in dire straits as Nielsen data reveals the decade-long slide.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f9b03b0d-9150-4d8c-8571-723901f41e04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Decade-long primetime plunge**
CNN's primetime audience fell from 1.3 million in 2016 to 553,000 now, with daytime viewership down from 752,000 to 433,000, marking a steeper 71-73% drop compared to 2021 peaks.
* **Leadership chaos fuels exodus**
Frequent CEO changes since Jeff Zucker's era, including Chris Licht's brief tenure, contributed to the decline after initial Trump-era gains faded under current management.
* **Digital pivot amid sale rumors**
CNN pushes streaming via All Access and vertical videos while denying parent Warner Bros. Discovery sale talks, though critics warn linear TV woes persist despite strong online reach of 120 million monthly users.

# NFL legend demands California Super Bowl ban
Former NFL quarterback Boomer Esiason called for **[barring California from hosting future Super Bowls](https://substack.com/redirect/c1ea8f84-c847-422f-bc89-1530caa9f462?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Seattle Seahawks QB Sam Darnold lost money on his championship bonus due to the state's "jock tax," which imposed higher taxes than his Super Bowl winnings following the game in California.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c1ea8f84-c847-422f-bc89-1530caa9f462?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Jock Tax Hits Hard** : California taxes non-resident players based on "duty days" in the state, extending beyond game day to include Super Bowl week activities and prior visits.
* **Darnold 's Net Loss: **Seahawks QB Sam Darnold earned $178,000 for winning the Super Bowl but owed $249,000 in California taxes, resulting in a $71,000 deficit.
* **Esiason 's Bold Call**: As a WFAN host, Esiason urged the NFLPA to refuse future Super Bowls in California, declaring the tax burden "ridiculous" and unsustainable for players.

# Disney's woke Snow White lost Disney MILLIONS
Disney's live-action Snow White remake, plagued by controversy and backlash, has **[suffered a staggering $170 million loss](https://substack.com/redirect/fe1fb873-3877-4f99-86b0-314bcdf6e332?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after grossing just $205.7 million worldwide against a bloated $336.5 million production budget, new financial filings reveal.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fe1fb873-3877-4f99-86b0-314bcdf6e332?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive Budget Ballooned** Production costs soared to $336.5 million, exceeding forecasts and surpassing expenses for major Disney hits like Rogue One, even after a $64.9 million U.K. tax rebate reduced net spending to $271.6 million.
* **Weak Box Office Haul** The film opened to $87.3 million globally--13% below expectations--and finished with only $205.7 million worldwide, ranking as the fifth-lowest grossing of Disney's 21 live-action animated remakes.
* **Theatrical Revenue Shortfall** After theaters claimed roughly half the gross, Disney retained about $102.9 million from box office alone, resulting in an estimated $168.7 million theatrical loss before additional costs like marketing.

Friend,

Before I ever thought about running for office, I was a dad, a husband, and a small business owner trying to navigate a broken system.

My wife Michelle is a pharmacist. A few years ago, we opened a brick-and-mortar pharmacy together -- just the two of us -- to help our neighbors access care, manage their health, and afford the medicine they need.

But we quickly realized something was deeply wrong.

Pharmacy Benefit Managers, the corporate middlemen who negotiate with drug manufacturers, weren’t negotiating for patients. They were driving up prices and pocketing the difference. They’ve made billions off the backs of working families.

**So I ran for Congress. And this week, the PBM Reform Act -- bipartisan legislation I proudly sponsored -- was signed into law.**

This bill will hold PBMs accountable. It forces transparency and stops them from arbitrarily jacking up prices at the expense of everyday Americans.

**It’s a big step forward, and it’s proof that when we bring real-world experience to Washington, we can deliver real results. But we’re not done.**

The same special interests that fought this bill are lining up to take back CA-45.

**[This is now the most vulnerable Democratic-held seat in Southern California, and the GOP is determined to buy it back. A few years ago, we opened a brick-and-mortar pharmacy together -- just the two of us -- to help our neighbors access care, manage their health, and afford the medicine they need. But we quickly realized something was deeply wrong. Pharmacy Benefit Managers, the corporate middlemen who negotiate with drug manufacturers, weren’t negotiating for patients. They were driving up prices and pocketing the difference. They’ve made billions off the backs of working families. So I ran for Congress. And this week, the PBM Reform Act -- bipartisan legislation I proudly sponsored -- was signed into law. This bill will hold PBMs accountable.
